# PHPStan Rules

Custom PHPStan rules provided by php-ai-toolkit. Each rule detects anti-patterns that actually occur in AI-generated code.

## Rector Support

Every rule below is classified as **Safe**, **Risky**, or **Unavailable** for automatic
changes. Enable the safe group with `withRules(SafeRules::rules())` or the risky
group with `withRules(RiskyRules::rules())` in `rector.php`. Both classes are in
`Toolkit\Rector`; their lists can be combined, and individual Rector classes can
also be registered with `withRules()`.
A classification describes only the supported cases; each rule’s Rector section
lists skipped cases and review requirements.

The legacy opt-in [ForbidMixedArrayReturnTypeRule](rules/ForbidMixedArrayReturnTypeRule.md#rector)
is also classified as **Unavailable**. Internal helper rules for mixed types and
class dispatch share their parent rule’s classification.

## General

Rules applied to all code.

| Rule | Description | Error Identifier | Rector |
|------|-------------|------------------|--------|
| [ForbiddenCommentRule](rules/ForbiddenCommentRule.md) | Forbids `@phpstan-ignore` and `@infection-ignore-all` comments | `customRules.phpstanIgnoreComment`, `customRules.infectionIgnoreAllComment` | [Risky](rules/ForbiddenCommentRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidFileTermRule](rules/ForbidFileTermRule.md) | Forbids configured literal terms in files matching restricted path patterns | `customRules.forbiddenFileTerm` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidFileTermRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidDependencyRule](rules/ForbidDependencyRule.md) | Forbids symbol and file-reading dependencies between configured paths; allows each root directory to depend only on itself and src by default | `customRules.forbiddenDependency` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidDependencyRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbiddenMagicMethodCallRule](rules/ForbiddenMagicMethodCallRule.md) | Forbids direct calls to magic methods | `customRules.forbiddenMagicMethodCall` | [Risky](rules/ForbiddenMagicMethodCallRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbiddenNamespaceRule](rules/ForbiddenNamespaceRule.md) | Forbids configured namespace prefixes and whole segments at any depth, including `Model`, `Models`, `Infrastructure`, and `Infrastructures` by default | `customRules.forbiddenNamespace` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbiddenNamespaceRule.md#rector) |
| [OverrideMustHaveAttributeRule](rules/OverrideMustHaveAttributeRule.md) | Requires `#[Override]` attribute on overridden methods | `customRules.overrideMustHaveAttribute` | [Safe](rules/OverrideMustHaveAttributeRule.md#rector) |
| [SrcUnitTestPairRule](rules/SrcUnitTestPairRule.md) | Enforces 1:1 pairing between `src/` classes and `tests/Unit/` test classes | `customRules.srcUnitTestPair` | [Unavailable](rules/SrcUnitTestPairRule.md#rector) |
| [RequirePhpDocOnPublicApiRule](rules/RequirePhpDocOnPublicApiRule.md) | Requires PHPDoc on all public API elements | `customRules.requirePhpDocOnPublicApi` | [Unavailable](rules/RequirePhpDocOnPublicApiRule.md#rector) |
| [RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule](rules/RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule.md) | Requires a runnable `@example` on declarations marked `@visibility public` | `customRules.requireExampleOnClass`, `customRules.requireExampleOnMethod`, `customRules.requireExampleOnProperty`, `customRules.requireExampleOnConstant`, `customRules.requireExampleOnEnumCase` | [Unavailable](rules/RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule.md#rector) |
| [EnforceVisibilityScopeRule](rules/EnforceVisibilityScopeRule.md) | Enforces namespace visibility scopes declared with `@visibility` and treats explicitly public API as externally used | `customRules.visibilityInvalidScope`, `customRules.visibilityOutOfScope` | [Unavailable](rules/EnforceVisibilityScopeRule.md#rector) |
| [EnforceMutationContractRule](rules/EnforceMutationContractRule.md) | Makes parameter, receiver, and global mutation explicit and propagates effects through statically resolved calls | `customRules.mutationInvalidContract`, `customRules.mutationUndeclared`, `customRules.mutationOverrideWidened` | [Unavailable](rules/EnforceMutationContractRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidNonDocCommentRule](rules/ForbidNonDocCommentRule.md) | Forbids `/* */` and `#` comments everywhere, and `//` comments outside `catch` blocks and array literals; `/** */` PHPDoc is allowed | `customRules.forbidNonDocComment` | [Risky](rules/ForbidNonDocCommentRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidSingleLinePhpDocRule](rules/ForbidSingleLinePhpDocRule.md) | Forbids single-line PHPDoc on public elements; requires multi-line format | `customRules.forbidSingleLinePhpDoc` | [Safe](rules/ForbidSingleLinePhpDocRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule](rules/ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule.md) | Forbids configured suffixes on class, interface, trait, and enum names | `customRules.forbiddenClassLikeNameSuffix` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule.md#rector) |
| [NoNonPublicMethodRule](rules/NoNonPublicMethodRule.md) | Forbids private methods and forbids protected methods outside abstract classes, traits, and override methods; constructors are exempt | `customRules.nonPublicMethod` | [Unavailable](rules/NoNonPublicMethodRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidEmptyCatchRule](rules/ForbidEmptyCatchRule.md) | Forbids catch blocks with an empty body | `customRules.emptyCatch` | [Risky](rules/ForbidEmptyCatchRule.md#rector) |
| [RequireThrowsTagOnDirectThrowRule](rules/RequireThrowsTagOnDirectThrowRule.md) | Requires `@throws` for exceptions thrown directly in a method and not caught within it | `customRules.missingThrowsTag` | [Risky](rules/RequireThrowsTagOnDirectThrowRule.md#rector) |
| [RequireExceptionChainingRule](rules/RequireExceptionChainingRule.md) | Requires new exceptions thrown inside catch blocks to chain the caught exception | `customRules.unchainedRethrow` | [Risky](rules/RequireExceptionChainingRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidBroadCatchRule](rules/ForbidBroadCatchRule.md) | Forbids catching `Throwable`, `Exception`, and the `LogicException`/`Error` families outside configured boundary paths | `customRules.broadCatch` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidBroadCatchRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidGenericThrowsTagRule](rules/ForbidGenericThrowsTagRule.md) | Forbids `@throws \Exception` and `@throws \Throwable` tags | `customRules.genericThrowsTag` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidGenericThrowsTagRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidInternalMixedTypeRule](rules/ForbidInternalMixedTypeRule.md) | Forbids explicit concrete `mixed` in internal declarations while allowing public, inherited, magic-protocol, and template contracts | `customRules.internalMixedType` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidInternalMixedTypeRule.md#rector) |
| [RequireListForArrayLiteralRule](rules/RequireListForArrayLiteralRule.md) | Requires `list<V>` instead of `array<int, V>` when a property or callable visibly owns a non-empty list literal; input parameters remain unrestricted | `customRules.arrayLiteralListType` | [Risky](rules/RequireListForArrayLiteralRule.md#rector) |
| [RequireExhaustiveDispatchRule](rules/RequireExhaustiveDispatchRule.md) | Requires a `switch` or `match` that names its subject — `match ($suit)`, or `match ($payment::class)` for a sealed hierarchy — to name a branch for every value that subject can hold, the way Rust and Kotlin check a match over a closed type | `customRules.exhaustiveDispatch`, `customRules.exhaustiveDispatchDefault` | [Unavailable](rules/RequireExhaustiveDispatchRule.md#rector) |

## Test Class

Rules applied to test classes in the `Tests\Unit` / `Tests\Integration` namespaces. Rules marked with `*` apply to all `Tests\` namespaces.

| Rule | Description | Error Identifier | Rector |
|------|-------------|------------------|--------|
| [NoPropertyInTestClassRule](rules/NoPropertyInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids property declarations in test classes | `customRules.noPropertyInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoPropertyInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [NoClassConstantInTestClassRule](rules/NoClassConstantInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids class constants in test classes | `customRules.noClassConstantInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoClassConstantInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [NoPrivateMethodInTestClassRule](rules/NoPrivateMethodInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids private methods in test classes | `customRules.noPrivateMethodInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoPrivateMethodInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [NoHelperMethodInTestClassRule](rules/NoHelperMethodInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids methods other than test/provider/override | `customRules.noHelperMethodInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoHelperMethodInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [NoControlFlowInTestMethodRule](rules/NoControlFlowInTestMethodRule.md) | Forbids control flow statements in test methods | `customRules.noControlFlowInTestMethod` | [Unavailable](rules/NoControlFlowInTestMethodRule.md#rector) |
| [NoTraitUseInTestClassRule](rules/NoTraitUseInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids trait usage in test classes | `customRules.noTraitUseInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoTraitUseInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [NoReflectionInTestClassRule](rules/NoReflectionInTestClassRule.md) `*` | Forbids Reflection API usage in test classes | `customRules.noReflectionInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoReflectionInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [NoRedundantAssertInstanceOfRule](rules/NoRedundantAssertInstanceOfRule.md) `*` | Forbids redundant PHPUnit `assertInstanceOf()` calls for values with one statically-known type | `customRules.noRedundantAssertInstanceOf` | [Unavailable](rules/NoRedundantAssertInstanceOfRule.md#rector) |
| [NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule](rules/NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule.md) `*` | Forbids `expectException()` / `expectExceptionObject()` for `Throwable` and the `LogicException`/`Error` families | `customRules.noBrokenCodeExpectation` | [Unavailable](rules/NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule.md#rector) |
| [PhpUnitMockApiRule](rules/PhpUnitMockApiRule.md) `*` | Restricts mock API and enforces interface-only mocking | `customRules.phpUnitMockApi` | [Unavailable](rules/PhpUnitMockApiRule.md#rector) |
| [ForbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClassRule](rules/ForbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids descriptive PHPDoc text in test classes | `customRules.forbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClass` | [Risky](rules/ForbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
| [PropertyTestConventionRule](rules/PropertyTestConventionRule.md) | Requires `tests/Property`, `<Name>Properties extends TestCase`, and executable public `satisfies<PropertyName>` methods | `customRules.propertyTestLocation`, `customRules.propertyTestClassName`, `customRules.propertyTestExtends`, `customRules.propertyTestMethodName`, `customRules.propertyTestMethodSignature`, `customRules.propertyTestDiscovery` | [Unavailable](rules/PropertyTestConventionRule.md#rector) |
| [TestNamingConventionRule](rules/TestNamingConventionRule.md) | Enforces naming conventions for test methods and data providers | `customRules.testNamingConvention` | [Unavailable](rules/TestNamingConventionRule.md#rector) |

## Enabling and Disabling Rules

Rules inherit `toolkit.allRules`, which defaults to `true`, except mutation
contracts, which are opt-in so an existing unannotated project does not change
semantics on upgrade. Override a specific rule through its `enabled` value:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        forbidEmptyCatch:
            enabled: false
```

Set `allRules: false` to make every rule opt-in. Toolkit adoption keeps the
default; changing a switch is an explicit project policy decision.

Enable mutation contracts explicitly with `toolkit.mutation.enabled: true`.

## Redundant PHPStan Diagnostics

The toolkit suppresses a PHPStan or Strict Rules diagnostic only when an enabled
toolkit rule makes that diagnostic non-actionable. The toolkit error remains as
the single instruction for fixing the prohibited construct:

| Enabled toolkit rule | Suppressed diagnostic | Scope |
|----------------------|-----------------------|-------|
| `noNonPublicMethod` | `method.unused`, `method.finalPrivate` | Private method declarations; PHPStan does not emit either for constructors, and `consistentConstructor.private` stays visible because the rule exempts constructors |
| `noPrivateMethodInTestClass` | The same private-method diagnostics | Restricted test classes |
| `noPropertyInTestClass` | `property.unused`, `property.neverRead`, `property.neverWritten`, `property.onlyRead`, `property.onlyWritten` | Restricted test classes |
| `noClassConstantInTestClass` | `classConstant.unused` | Restricted test classes |
| `noControlFlowInTestMethod` | PHPStan and Strict Rules diagnostics emitted for the prohibited `if`, loop, `switch`, or `match` node | Test methods in restricted test classes |
| `requireThrowsTagOnDirectThrow` | `missingType.checkedException` | Direct escaping throws in methods; propagated checked exceptions remain reported |

This is semantic suppression through PHPStan's extension API, not a global
`ignoreErrors` entry. Disabling the dominating toolkit rule automatically
restores the corresponding PHPStan diagnostics. Independent findings remain
visible; for example, an unused private property in production code and a dead
broad catch are still reported.

## Parameters

The following values can be customized under `parameters.toolkit` in a project's
`phpstan.neon`:

| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `testNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests']` | Test namespace prefixes |
| `restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests\Unit', 'Tests\Integration', 'Tests\Property']` | Test namespaces where strict rules apply |
| `visibilityExemptNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests']` | Namespace subtrees allowed to reference declarations across `@visibility` boundaries |
| `srcUnitTestPairExcludePatterns` | `[]` | Patterns to exclude from test pair checks |
| `srcMarker` | `'/src/'` | Source code path marker |
| `unitTestMarker` | `'/tests/Unit/'` | Unit test path marker |
| `forbiddenTermsByPath` | `[]` | Map of restricted file path patterns to case-insensitive literal terms forbidden anywhere in matching files |
| `dependencyProjectRoot` | `%currentWorkingDirectory%` | Absolute root for dependency boundary patterns |
| `forbiddenDependencies` | Root directories may depend on themselves and `src/**`; `vendor/**` and root files are exempt | Directed `from`/`to` path policies with optional `excludeFrom`, `excludeTo`, and `allowSameRootDirectory` |
| `dependencyFileReaders` | `[]` | Additional function or `Class::method` file readers with argument `position` and `name`; built-ins remain active |
| `forbiddenNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests\Support', 'Tests\Supports', 'Tests\Helper', 'Tests\Helpers', 'Tests\Util', 'Tests\Utils', 'Tests\Utility', 'Tests\Utilities', 'Tests\Fixture', 'Tests\Fixtures']` | Namespace prefixes to forbid |
| `forbiddenNamespaceSegments` | `['Model', 'Models', 'Infrastructure', 'Infrastructures']` | Whole namespace segments to forbid at any depth; matching is case-sensitive |
| `forbiddenClassLikeNameSuffixes` | See [`rules.neon`](../rules.neon) | Class-like declaration name suffixes to forbid |
| `broadCatchAllowedPaths` | `[]` | fnmatch patterns of boundary files allowed to catch `Throwable`, `Exception`, and the `LogicException`/`Error` families |

1	# PHPStan Rules
2	
3	Custom PHPStan rules provided by php-ai-toolkit. Each rule detects anti-patterns that actually occur in AI-generated code.
4	
5	## Rector Support
6	
7	Every rule below is classified as **Safe**, **Risky**, or **Unavailable** for automatic
8	changes. Enable the safe group with `withRules(SafeRules::rules())` or the risky
9	group with `withRules(RiskyRules::rules())` in `rector.php`. Both classes are in
10	`Toolkit\Rector`; their lists can be combined, and individual Rector classes can
11	also be registered with `withRules()`.
12	A classification describes only the supported cases; each rule’s Rector section
13	lists skipped cases and review requirements.
14	
15	The legacy opt-in [ForbidMixedArrayReturnTypeRule](rules/ForbidMixedArrayReturnTypeRule.md#rector)
16	is also classified as **Unavailable**. Internal helper rules for mixed types and
17	class dispatch share their parent rule’s classification.
18	
19	## General
20	
21	Rules applied to all code.
22	
23	| Rule | Description | Error Identifier | Rector |
24	|------|-------------|------------------|--------|
25	| [ForbiddenCommentRule](rules/ForbiddenCommentRule.md) | Forbids `@phpstan-ignore` and `@infection-ignore-all` comments | `customRules.phpstanIgnoreComment`, `customRules.infectionIgnoreAllComment` | [Risky](rules/ForbiddenCommentRule.md#rector) |
26	| [ForbidFileTermRule](rules/ForbidFileTermRule.md) | Forbids configured literal terms in files matching restricted path patterns | `customRules.forbiddenFileTerm` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidFileTermRule.md#rector) |
27	| [ForbidDependencyRule](rules/ForbidDependencyRule.md) | Forbids symbol and file-reading dependencies between configured paths; allows each root directory to depend only on itself and src by default | `customRules.forbiddenDependency` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidDependencyRule.md#rector) |
28	| [ForbiddenMagicMethodCallRule](rules/ForbiddenMagicMethodCallRule.md) | Forbids direct calls to magic methods | `customRules.forbiddenMagicMethodCall` | [Risky](rules/ForbiddenMagicMethodCallRule.md#rector) |
29	| [ForbiddenNamespaceRule](rules/ForbiddenNamespaceRule.md) | Forbids configured namespace prefixes and whole segments at any depth, including `Model`, `Models`, `Infrastructure`, and `Infrastructures` by default | `customRules.forbiddenNamespace` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbiddenNamespaceRule.md#rector) |
30	| [OverrideMustHaveAttributeRule](rules/OverrideMustHaveAttributeRule.md) | Requires `#[Override]` attribute on overridden methods | `customRules.overrideMustHaveAttribute` | [Safe](rules/OverrideMustHaveAttributeRule.md#rector) |
31	| [SrcUnitTestPairRule](rules/SrcUnitTestPairRule.md) | Enforces 1:1 pairing between `src/` classes and `tests/Unit/` test classes | `customRules.srcUnitTestPair` | [Unavailable](rules/SrcUnitTestPairRule.md#rector) |
32	| [RequirePhpDocOnPublicApiRule](rules/RequirePhpDocOnPublicApiRule.md) | Requires PHPDoc on all public API elements | `customRules.requirePhpDocOnPublicApi` | [Unavailable](rules/RequirePhpDocOnPublicApiRule.md#rector) |
33	| [RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule](rules/RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule.md) | Requires a runnable `@example` on declarations marked `@visibility public` | `customRules.requireExampleOnClass`, `customRules.requireExampleOnMethod`, `customRules.requireExampleOnProperty`, `customRules.requireExampleOnConstant`, `customRules.requireExampleOnEnumCase` | [Unavailable](rules/RequireExampleOnPublicApiRule.md#rector) |
34	| [EnforceVisibilityScopeRule](rules/EnforceVisibilityScopeRule.md) | Enforces namespace visibility scopes declared with `@visibility` and treats explicitly public API as externally used | `customRules.visibilityInvalidScope`, `customRules.visibilityOutOfScope` | [Unavailable](rules/EnforceVisibilityScopeRule.md#rector) |
35	| [EnforceMutationContractRule](rules/EnforceMutationContractRule.md) | Makes parameter, receiver, and global mutation explicit and propagates effects through statically resolved calls | `customRules.mutationInvalidContract`, `customRules.mutationUndeclared`, `customRules.mutationOverrideWidened` | [Unavailable](rules/EnforceMutationContractRule.md#rector) |
36	| [ForbidNonDocCommentRule](rules/ForbidNonDocCommentRule.md) | Forbids `/* */` and `#` comments everywhere, and `//` comments outside `catch` blocks and array literals; `/** */` PHPDoc is allowed | `customRules.forbidNonDocComment` | [Risky](rules/ForbidNonDocCommentRule.md#rector) |
37	| [ForbidSingleLinePhpDocRule](rules/ForbidSingleLinePhpDocRule.md) | Forbids single-line PHPDoc on public elements; requires multi-line format | `customRules.forbidSingleLinePhpDoc` | [Safe](rules/ForbidSingleLinePhpDocRule.md#rector) |
38	| [ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule](rules/ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule.md) | Forbids configured suffixes on class, interface, trait, and enum names | `customRules.forbiddenClassLikeNameSuffix` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule.md#rector) |
39	| [NoNonPublicMethodRule](rules/NoNonPublicMethodRule.md) | Forbids private methods and forbids protected methods outside abstract classes, traits, and override methods; constructors are exempt | `customRules.nonPublicMethod` | [Unavailable](rules/NoNonPublicMethodRule.md#rector) |
40	| [ForbidEmptyCatchRule](rules/ForbidEmptyCatchRule.md) | Forbids catch blocks with an empty body | `customRules.emptyCatch` | [Risky](rules/ForbidEmptyCatchRule.md#rector) |
41	| [RequireThrowsTagOnDirectThrowRule](rules/RequireThrowsTagOnDirectThrowRule.md) | Requires `@throws` for exceptions thrown directly in a method and not caught within it | `customRules.missingThrowsTag` | [Risky](rules/RequireThrowsTagOnDirectThrowRule.md#rector) |
42	| [RequireExceptionChainingRule](rules/RequireExceptionChainingRule.md) | Requires new exceptions thrown inside catch blocks to chain the caught exception | `customRules.unchainedRethrow` | [Risky](rules/RequireExceptionChainingRule.md#rector) |
43	| [ForbidBroadCatchRule](rules/ForbidBroadCatchRule.md) | Forbids catching `Throwable`, `Exception`, and the `LogicException`/`Error` families outside configured boundary paths | `customRules.broadCatch` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidBroadCatchRule.md#rector) |
44	| [ForbidGenericThrowsTagRule](rules/ForbidGenericThrowsTagRule.md) | Forbids `@throws \Exception` and `@throws \Throwable` tags | `customRules.genericThrowsTag` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidGenericThrowsTagRule.md#rector) |
45	| [ForbidInternalMixedTypeRule](rules/ForbidInternalMixedTypeRule.md) | Forbids explicit concrete `mixed` in internal declarations while allowing public, inherited, magic-protocol, and template contracts | `customRules.internalMixedType` | [Unavailable](rules/ForbidInternalMixedTypeRule.md#rector) |
46	| [RequireListForArrayLiteralRule](rules/RequireListForArrayLiteralRule.md) | Requires `list<V>` instead of `array<int, V>` when a property or callable visibly owns a non-empty list literal; input parameters remain unrestricted | `customRules.arrayLiteralListType` | [Risky](rules/RequireListForArrayLiteralRule.md#rector) |
47	| [RequireExhaustiveDispatchRule](rules/RequireExhaustiveDispatchRule.md) | Requires a `switch` or `match` that names its subject — `match ($suit)`, or `match ($payment::class)` for a sealed hierarchy — to name a branch for every value that subject can hold, the way Rust and Kotlin check a match over a closed type | `customRules.exhaustiveDispatch`, `customRules.exhaustiveDispatchDefault` | [Unavailable](rules/RequireExhaustiveDispatchRule.md#rector) |
48	
49	## Test Class
50	
51	Rules applied to test classes in the `Tests\Unit` / `Tests\Integration` namespaces. Rules marked with `*` apply to all `Tests\` namespaces.
52	
53	| Rule | Description | Error Identifier | Rector |
54	|------|-------------|------------------|--------|
55	| [NoPropertyInTestClassRule](rules/NoPropertyInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids property declarations in test classes | `customRules.noPropertyInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoPropertyInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
56	| [NoClassConstantInTestClassRule](rules/NoClassConstantInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids class constants in test classes | `customRules.noClassConstantInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoClassConstantInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
57	| [NoPrivateMethodInTestClassRule](rules/NoPrivateMethodInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids private methods in test classes | `customRules.noPrivateMethodInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoPrivateMethodInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
58	| [NoHelperMethodInTestClassRule](rules/NoHelperMethodInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids methods other than test/provider/override | `customRules.noHelperMethodInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoHelperMethodInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
59	| [NoControlFlowInTestMethodRule](rules/NoControlFlowInTestMethodRule.md) | Forbids control flow statements in test methods | `customRules.noControlFlowInTestMethod` | [Unavailable](rules/NoControlFlowInTestMethodRule.md#rector) |
60	| [NoTraitUseInTestClassRule](rules/NoTraitUseInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids trait usage in test classes | `customRules.noTraitUseInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoTraitUseInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
61	| [NoReflectionInTestClassRule](rules/NoReflectionInTestClassRule.md) `*` | Forbids Reflection API usage in test classes | `customRules.noReflectionInTestClass` | [Unavailable](rules/NoReflectionInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
62	| [NoRedundantAssertInstanceOfRule](rules/NoRedundantAssertInstanceOfRule.md) `*` | Forbids redundant PHPUnit `assertInstanceOf()` calls for values with one statically-known type | `customRules.noRedundantAssertInstanceOf` | [Unavailable](rules/NoRedundantAssertInstanceOfRule.md#rector) |
63	| [NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule](rules/NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule.md) `*` | Forbids `expectException()` / `expectExceptionObject()` for `Throwable` and the `LogicException`/`Error` families | `customRules.noBrokenCodeExpectation` | [Unavailable](rules/NoBrokenCodeExpectationRule.md#rector) |
64	| [PhpUnitMockApiRule](rules/PhpUnitMockApiRule.md) `*` | Restricts mock API and enforces interface-only mocking | `customRules.phpUnitMockApi` | [Unavailable](rules/PhpUnitMockApiRule.md#rector) |
65	| [ForbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClassRule](rules/ForbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClassRule.md) | Forbids descriptive PHPDoc text in test classes | `customRules.forbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClass` | [Risky](rules/ForbidDescriptivePhpDocInTestClassRule.md#rector) |
66	| [PropertyTestConventionRule](rules/PropertyTestConventionRule.md) | Requires `tests/Property`, `<Name>Properties extends TestCase`, and executable public `satisfies<PropertyName>` methods | `customRules.propertyTestLocation`, `customRules.propertyTestClassName`, `customRules.propertyTestExtends`, `customRules.propertyTestMethodName`, `customRules.propertyTestMethodSignature`, `customRules.propertyTestDiscovery` | [Unavailable](rules/PropertyTestConventionRule.md#rector) |
67	| [TestNamingConventionRule](rules/TestNamingConventionRule.md) | Enforces naming conventions for test methods and data providers | `customRules.testNamingConvention` | [Unavailable](rules/TestNamingConventionRule.md#rector) |
68	
69	## Enabling and Disabling Rules
70	
71	Rules inherit `toolkit.allRules`, which defaults to `true`, except mutation
72	contracts, which are opt-in so an existing unannotated project does not change
73	semantics on upgrade. Override a specific rule through its `enabled` value:
74	
75	```neon
76	parameters:
77	    toolkit:
78	        forbidEmptyCatch:
79	            enabled: false
80	```
81	
82	Set `allRules: false` to make every rule opt-in. Toolkit adoption keeps the
83	default; changing a switch is an explicit project policy decision.
84	
85	Enable mutation contracts explicitly with `toolkit.mutation.enabled: true`.
86	
87	## Redundant PHPStan Diagnostics
88	
89	The toolkit suppresses a PHPStan or Strict Rules diagnostic only when an enabled
90	toolkit rule makes that diagnostic non-actionable. The toolkit error remains as
91	the single instruction for fixing the prohibited construct:
92	
93	| Enabled toolkit rule | Suppressed diagnostic | Scope |
94	|----------------------|-----------------------|-------|
95	| `noNonPublicMethod` | `method.unused`, `method.finalPrivate` | Private method declarations; PHPStan does not emit either for constructors, and `consistentConstructor.private` stays visible because the rule exempts constructors |
96	| `noPrivateMethodInTestClass` | The same private-method diagnostics | Restricted test classes |
97	| `noPropertyInTestClass` | `property.unused`, `property.neverRead`, `property.neverWritten`, `property.onlyRead`, `property.onlyWritten` | Restricted test classes |
98	| `noClassConstantInTestClass` | `classConstant.unused` | Restricted test classes |
99	| `noControlFlowInTestMethod` | PHPStan and Strict Rules diagnostics emitted for the prohibited `if`, loop, `switch`, or `match` node | Test methods in restricted test classes |
100	| `requireThrowsTagOnDirectThrow` | `missingType.checkedException` | Direct escaping throws in methods; propagated checked exceptions remain reported |
101	
102	This is semantic suppression through PHPStan's extension API, not a global
103	`ignoreErrors` entry. Disabling the dominating toolkit rule automatically
104	restores the corresponding PHPStan diagnostics. Independent findings remain
105	visible; for example, an unused private property in production code and a dead
106	broad catch are still reported.
107	
108	## Parameters
109	
110	The following values can be customized under `parameters.toolkit` in a project's
111	`phpstan.neon`:
112	
113	| Parameter | Default | Description |
114	|-----------|---------|-------------|
115	| `testNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests']` | Test namespace prefixes |
116	| `restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests\Unit', 'Tests\Integration', 'Tests\Property']` | Test namespaces where strict rules apply |
117	| `visibilityExemptNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests']` | Namespace subtrees allowed to reference declarations across `@visibility` boundaries |
118	| `srcUnitTestPairExcludePatterns` | `[]` | Patterns to exclude from test pair checks |
119	| `srcMarker` | `'/src/'` | Source code path marker |
120	| `unitTestMarker` | `'/tests/Unit/'` | Unit test path marker |
121	| `forbiddenTermsByPath` | `[]` | Map of restricted file path patterns to case-insensitive literal terms forbidden anywhere in matching files |
122	| `dependencyProjectRoot` | `%currentWorkingDirectory%` | Absolute root for dependency boundary patterns |
123	| `forbiddenDependencies` | Root directories may depend on themselves and `src/**`; `vendor/**` and root files are exempt | Directed `from`/`to` path policies with optional `excludeFrom`, `excludeTo`, and `allowSameRootDirectory` |
124	| `dependencyFileReaders` | `[]` | Additional function or `Class::method` file readers with argument `position` and `name`; built-ins remain active |
125	| `forbiddenNamespacePrefixes` | `['Tests\Support', 'Tests\Supports', 'Tests\Helper', 'Tests\Helpers', 'Tests\Util', 'Tests\Utils', 'Tests\Utility', 'Tests\Utilities', 'Tests\Fixture', 'Tests\Fixtures']` | Namespace prefixes to forbid |
126	| `forbiddenNamespaceSegments` | `['Model', 'Models', 'Infrastructure', 'Infrastructures']` | Whole namespace segments to forbid at any depth; matching is case-sensitive |
127	| `forbiddenClassLikeNameSuffixes` | See [`rules.neon`](../rules.neon) | Class-like declaration name suffixes to forbid |
128	| `broadCatchAllowedPaths` | `[]` | fnmatch patterns of boundary files allowed to catch `Throwable`, `Exception`, and the `LogicException`/`Error` families |

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Architecture;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;
use PHPStan\Reflection\ReflectionProvider;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\Rule;
use PHPStan\Rules\RuleErrorBuilder;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Architecture\Dependency\DependencyCallResolver;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Architecture\Dependency\DependencyPath;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Architecture\Dependency\DependencyRestrictions;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Architecture\Dependency\FileDependencyResolver;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Architecture\Dependency\SymbolDependencyResolver;

/**
 * Forbids configured symbol and file-reading dependencies between project paths.
 *
 * @implements Rule<Node>
 */
final class ForbidDependencyRule implements Rule
{
    private DependencyPath $paths;

    private DependencyRestrictions $restrictions;

    private SymbolDependencyResolver $symbols;

    private FileDependencyResolver $files;

    /**
     * @param list<array{from: list<string>, excludeFrom?: list<string>, to: list<string>, excludeTo?: list<string>, allowSameRootDirectory?: bool}> $forbiddenDependencies
     * @param array<string, array{position: int, name: string}> $dependencyFileReaders
     */
    public function __construct(
        ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider,
        string $dependencyProjectRoot,
        array $forbiddenDependencies = DependencyRestrictions::DEFAULTS,
        array $dependencyFileReaders = [],
    ) {
        $this->paths = new DependencyPath($dependencyProjectRoot);
        $this->restrictions = new DependencyRestrictions($this->paths, $forbiddenDependencies);
        $calls = new DependencyCallResolver($reflectionProvider);
        $this->symbols = new SymbolDependencyResolver($reflectionProvider, $calls);
        $this->files = new FileDependencyResolver($calls, $this->paths, $dependencyFileReaders);
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string<Node>
     */
    public function getNodeType(): string
    {
        return Node::class;
    }

    /**
     * Reports each resolved forbidden destination once per reference node.
     *
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function processNode(Node $node, Scope $scope): array
    {
        $source = $scope->isInTrait() ? $scope->getTraitReflection()->getFileName() ?? $scope->getFile() : $scope->getFile();
        if (!$this->restrictions->checks($source)) {
            return [];
        }

        $errors = [];
        $targets = $this->symbols->resolve($node, $scope) + $this->files->resolve($node, $scope);
        foreach ($targets as $target => $description) {
            $pattern = $this->restrictions->violation($source, $target);
            if ($pattern === null) {
                continue;
            }
            $errors[] = RuleErrorBuilder::message(sprintf(
                'Forbidden dependency from "%s" to "%s" via %s (target pattern "%s"). Remove the reference or move the referenced code/data to an allowed path.',
                $this->paths->display($source),
                $this->paths->display($target),
                $description,
                $pattern,
            ))->identifier('customRules.forbiddenDependency')->file($source)->line($node->getStartLine())->build();
        }

        return $errors;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Naming;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\ClassLike;
use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\Rule;
use PHPStan\Rules\RuleErrorBuilder;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\Shared\ClassLikeKindLabel;

/**
 * Forbids configured suffixes on class-like declaration names.
 *
 * @implements Rule<\PhpParser\Node\Stmt\ClassLike>
 */
final class ForbidClassLikeNameSuffixRule implements Rule
{
    /** @readonly */
    private ForbiddenClassLikeSuffixes $forbiddenSuffixes;

    /** @readonly */
    private ClassLikeKindLabel $kindLabel;

    /**
     * @param list<string> $forbiddenSuffixes class-like name suffixes to forbid
     */
    public function __construct(array $forbiddenSuffixes = [])
    {
        $this->forbiddenSuffixes = new ForbiddenClassLikeSuffixes($forbiddenSuffixes);
        $this->kindLabel = new ClassLikeKindLabel();
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string<ClassLike>
     */
    public function getNodeType(): string
    {
        return ClassLike::class;
    }

    /**
     * @param ClassLike $node
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function processNode(Node $node, Scope $scope): array
    {
        if ($node->name === null) {
            return [];
        }

        $name = $node->name->toString();
        $suffix = $this->forbiddenSuffixes->matchingSuffix($name);

        if ($suffix === null) {
            return [];
        }

        $kind = $this->kindLabel->label($node);

        return [
            RuleErrorBuilder::message(
                sprintf(
                    'Rename %s %s to a specific domain name without the "%s" suffix.',
                    $kind,
                    $name,
                    $suffix
                )
            )
                ->identifier('customRules.forbiddenClassLikeNameSuffix')
                ->line($node->getStartLine())
                ->build(),
        ];
    }
}

# phpstan-guard-rules

[![PHP](https://img.shields.io/badge/php-8.0%2B-777bb4?logo=php&logoColor=white)](https://www.php.net/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

Strict PHPStan rules for AI-assisted PHP development, covering production code,
public API contracts, and test design.

## Requirements

- PHP 8.0 or later
- PHPStan 1.12 or later on 1.x, and 2.x

## Getting Started

```console
$ composer require --dev k-kinzal/phpstan-guard-rules
```

Include the shipped rules and PHPStan's strict rules in `phpstan.neon`:

```neon
includes:
    - vendor/phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules/rules.neon
    - vendor/k-kinzal/phpstan-guard-rules/rules.neon

parameters:
    level: max
    paths:
        - src
        - tests
```

If `phpstan/extension-installer` already loads these files, omit the explicit
includes. Adjust the analysis paths to your project, then run the analysis:

```console
$ vendor/bin/phpstan analyse
```

See the [rule reference](docs/phpstan.md) for individual rules and configuration.

### Rector

Optional Rector rules can fix some of the findings. They require Rector 2.6.7 or
later on 2.x and PHPStan 2. Install Rector, then enable the safe group in `rector.php`:

```console
$ composer require --dev rector/rector:^2.6.7
```

```php
<?php

use Rector\Config\RectorConfig;
use Toolkit\Rector\SafeRules;

return RectorConfig::configure()
    ->withPaths([__DIR__ . '/src', __DIR__ . '/tests'])
    ->withRules(SafeRules::rules());
```

Preview the proposed changes:

```console
$ vendor/bin/rector process --dry-run
```

`SafeRules::rules()` provides the two safe rules; `RiskyRules::rules()` provides
the eight risky rules.
Review their behavioral or contract changes before adding the risky group.
The [rule reference](docs/phpstan.md#rector-support) records automatic-fix
availability and review requirements for every rule.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

1	# ForbidDependencyRule
2	
3	| Property | Value |
4	|----------|-------|
5	| Identifier | `customRules.forbiddenDependency` |
6	| Scope | Symbol references and file access in analyzed PHP files |
7	| Rector | Unavailable |
8	| Configurable | Yes (`forbiddenDependencies`, `dependencyProjectRoot`, `dependencyFileReaders`) |
9	
10	## Default Policy
11	
12	Each project-root directory is a dependency boundary. Code may depend on files
13	inside its own root directory and inside `src/`, but must not reuse files from
14	other root directories. This applies to both PHP symbols and file-reading APIs.
15	New directories receive the same boundary without enumerating them in config.
16	
17	| Source | Allowed project directories |
18	|--------|-----------------------------|
19	| `src/**` | `src/**` |
20	| `tests/**` | `tests/**`, `src/**` |
21	| `examples/**` | `examples/**`, `src/**` |
22	| `bench/**` | `bench/**`, `src/**` |
23	| Any other root directory | That directory and `src/**` |
24	
25	The boundary uses the first path segment, so `tests/Unit` may reference
26	`tests/Integration`. `example/` and `examples/` are separate boundaries and cannot
27	reference each other. `fixtures/`, `config/`, and `resources/` are also separate
28	boundaries. Test inputs belong inside `tests/`; do not create a separate root
29	directory and exempt it from the boundary to share test-only code or data.
30	
31	`vendor/` is exempt as both a source and destination so Composer library use is
32	permitted. Files directly at the project root, such as `composer.json` and
33	`bootstrap.php`, are outside this directory boundary in both directions. Paths
34	outside the configured project are also outside the policy's scope. These are
35	project architecture checks, not a filesystem sandbox.
36	
37	The distributed configuration is:
38	
39	```neon
40	parameters:
41	    toolkit:
42	        dependencyProjectRoot: %currentWorkingDirectory%
43	        forbiddenDependencies:
44	            -
45	                from: ['*/**']
46	                excludeFrom: ['vendor/**']
47	                to: ['*/**']
48	                excludeTo: ['src/**', 'vendor/**']
49	                allowSameRootDirectory: true
50	```
51	
52	Run PHPStan from the project root, or set `dependencyProjectRoot` to the absolute
53	project directory when invoking PHPStan from another directory. Paths do not
54	infer their root from namespace names, nested Composer files, or arbitrary
55	occurrences of a directory name in a filename.
56	
57	## Custom Boundaries
58	
59	Each policy has `from` and `to` lists of root-relative glob patterns. Optional
60	`excludeFrom` and `excludeTo` lists exempt sources and destinations respectively.
61	`allowSameRootDirectory: true` also exempts references within the same project-root
62	directory; its default is `false` for custom policies.
63	
64	A dependency is forbidden if its source matches `from`, its destination matches
65	`to`, and none of that policy's exemptions apply. Exemptions affect only their
66	own policy. Overlapping policies produce one finding per destination at a
67	reference node.
68	
69	For example, add a narrower restriction within `src/`:
70	
71	```neon
72	parameters:
73	    toolkit:
74	        forbiddenDependencies:
75	            -
76	                from: ['src/Public/**']
77	                to: ['src/Internal/**']
78	```
79	
80	PHPStan merges list configuration, so this adds to the root-directory boundary.
81	Appending an exemption does not relax another policy. Use
82	`forbiddenDependencies!:` when deliberately replacing the entire list, or
83	`forbiddenDependencies!: []` for an empty policy list.
84	
85	Matching is case-sensitive and anchored at the project root. `*` matches within
86	one path segment, `**` crosses directory boundaries, `**/` also matches zero
87	directories, and `?` matches one non-separator character. Separators and `.`/`..`
88	segments are normalized; existing symlink destinations are also checked. A
89	symlink crossing root directories does not receive the same-directory exemption.
90	
91	## Symbol Dependencies
92	
93	The rule checks the declaration file PHPStan resolves for:
94	
95	- class instantiation, static calls, class constants, enum cases, and `::class`;
96	- inheritance, interfaces, trait use, attributes, and `instanceof`;
97	- native parameter, return, property, and catch types;
98	- function calls and global constants, including imported aliases;
99	- methods and properties with a statically known receiver; and
100	- dynamic class references when PHPStan knows one constant class name.
101	
102	Method dependencies use the method's declaring class, including inherited
103	methods. Unused imports, PHPDoc-only type references, and transitive dependencies
104	through an otherwise allowed declaration are not independently traversed.
105	
106	PHPStan must be able to discover the referenced declarations. Composer autoload
107	metadata, analyzed paths, and `scanDirectories`/`scanFiles` all work. When examples
108	are excluded from analysis and are not autoloaded, add the existing directories
109	to `scanDirectories`:
110	
111	```neon
112	parameters:
113	    scanDirectories:
114	        - examples
115	```
116	
117	This discovers symbols without executing the example or analyzing its body.
118	Include `tests/` in PHPStan's analyzed paths to check test dependencies. An
119	unknown symbol remains subject to PHPStan's own unknown-symbol diagnostics.
120	
121	## File Dependencies
122	
123	All four `include`/`require` forms are checked. Built-in reader registrations
124	cover `file_get_contents`, `fopen`, `file`, `readfile`, `parse_ini_file`,
125	`simplexml_load_file`, `hash_file`, `md5_file`, `sha1_file`, and
126	`SplFileObject::__construct`. Opening a file counts as a dependency regardless
127	of the requested mode.
128	
129	Only the registered path argument is checked. Imported function aliases and
130	reordered named arguments are resolved. A namespaced function merely named
131	`file_get_contents` does not inherit the built-in registration.
132	
133	```php
134	require __DIR__ . '/../examples/bootstrap.php'; // Forbidden from tests/.
135	file_get_contents(dirname(__DIR__) . '/examples/input.json'); // Forbidden.
136	file_get_contents(filename: __DIR__ . '/../examples/input.json'); // Forbidden.
137	
138	echo 'See examples/input.json'; // An explanation, not a file dependency.
139	file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/data/input.json'); // Same tests/ directory: allowed.
140	file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/../fixtures/input.json'); // Forbidden: keep test inputs inside tests/.
141	```
142	
143	The path evaluator handles string literals, `__DIR__`, `__FILE__`, concatenation,

# ForbidDependencyRule

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Identifier | `customRules.forbiddenDependency` |
| Scope | Symbol references and file access in analyzed PHP files |
| Rector | Unavailable |
| Configurable | Yes (`forbiddenDependencies`, `dependencyProjectRoot`, `dependencyFileReaders`) |

## Default Policy

Each project-root directory is a dependency boundary. Code may depend on files
inside its own root directory and inside `src/`, but must not reuse files from
other root directories. This applies to both PHP symbols and file-reading APIs.
New directories receive the same boundary without enumerating them in config.

| Source | Allowed project directories |
|--------|-----------------------------|
| `src/**` | `src/**` |
| `tests/**` | `tests/**`, `src/**` |
| `examples/**` | `examples/**`, `src/**` |
| `bench/**` | `bench/**`, `src/**` |
| Any other root directory | That directory and `src/**` |

The boundary uses the first path segment, so `tests/Unit` may reference
`tests/Integration`. `example/` and `examples/` are separate boundaries and cannot
reference each other. `fixtures/`, `config/`, and `resources/` are also separate
boundaries. Test inputs belong inside `tests/`; do not create a separate root
directory and exempt it from the boundary to share test-only code or data.

`vendor/` is exempt as both a source and destination so Composer library use is
permitted. Files directly at the project root, such as `composer.json` and
`bootstrap.php`, are outside this directory boundary in both directions. Paths
outside the configured project are also outside the policy's scope. These are
project architecture checks, not a filesystem sandbox.

The distributed configuration is:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        dependencyProjectRoot: %currentWorkingDirectory%
        forbiddenDependencies:
            -
                from: ['*/**']
                excludeFrom: ['vendor/**']
                to: ['*/**']
                excludeTo: ['src/**', 'vendor/**']
                allowSameRootDirectory: true
```

Run PHPStan from the project root, or set `dependencyProjectRoot` to the absolute
project directory when invoking PHPStan from another directory. Paths do not
infer their root from namespace names, nested Composer files, or arbitrary
occurrences of a directory name in a filename.

## Custom Boundaries

Each policy has `from` and `to` lists of root-relative glob patterns. Optional
`excludeFrom` and `excludeTo` lists exempt sources and destinations respectively.
`allowSameRootDirectory: true` also exempts references within the same project-root
directory; its default is `false` for custom policies.

A dependency is forbidden if its source matches `from`, its destination matches
`to`, and none of that policy's exemptions apply. Exemptions affect only their
own policy. Overlapping policies produce one finding per destination at a
reference node.

For example, add a narrower restriction within `src/`:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        forbiddenDependencies:
            -
                from: ['src/Public/**']
                to: ['src/Internal/**']
```

Appending an exemption does not relax another policy. Use
`forbiddenDependencies!:` when deliberately replacing the entire list, or
`forbiddenDependencies!: []` for an empty policy list.

Matching is case-sensitive and anchored at the project root. `*` matches within
one path segment, `**` crosses directory boundaries, `**/` also matches zero
directories, and `?` matches one non-separator character. Separators and `.`/`..`
segments are normalized; existing symlink destinations are also checked. A
symlink crossing root directories does not receive the same-directory exemption.

## Symbol Dependencies

The rule checks the declaration file PHPStan resolves for:

- class instantiation, static calls, class constants, enum cases, and `::class`;
- inheritance, interfaces, trait use, attributes, and `instanceof`;
- native parameter, return, property, and catch types;
- function calls and global constants, including imported aliases;
- methods and properties with a statically known receiver; and
- dynamic class references when PHPStan knows one constant class name.

Method dependencies use the method's declaring class, including inherited
methods. Unused imports, PHPDoc-only type references, and transitive dependencies
through an otherwise allowed declaration are not independently traversed.

PHPStan must be able to discover the referenced declarations. Composer autoload
metadata, analyzed paths, and `scanDirectories`/`scanFiles` all work. When examples
are excluded from analysis and are not autoloaded, add the existing directories
to `scanDirectories`:

```neon
parameters:
    scanDirectories:

```

Include `tests/` in PHPStan's analyzed paths to check test dependencies. An
unknown symbol remains subject to PHPStan's own unknown-symbol diagnostics.

`simplexml_load_file`, `hash_file`, `md5_file`, `sha1_file`, and
`SplFileObject::__construct`. Opening a file counts as a dependency regardless
of the requested mode.

reordered named arguments are resolved. A namespaced function merely named
`file_get_contents` does not inherit the built-in registration.

```php

file_get_contents(filename: __DIR__ . '/../examples/input.json'); // Forbidden.

echo 'See examples/input.json'; // An explanation, not a file dependency.
file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/data/input.json'); // Same tests/ directory: allowed.
file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/../fixtures/input.json'); // Forbidden: keep test inputs inside tests/.
```

The path evaluator handles string literals, `__DIR__`, `__FILE__`, concatenation,
built-in `dirname()` with constant arguments, and expressions PHPStan resolves
to one constant string. Absolute local paths and `file:///` paths are supported.

equals the analysis project root. Remote URLs, other stream wrappers, unpacked
path arguments, uncertain unions, and paths or call targets only known at runtime
are left unresolved. Variables containing generalized strings, including some
paths assigned from `__DIR__`, may consequently remain unresolved. Use a directly
resolvable path expression when this boundary must be checked.

## Registering File Readers

Add fully qualified function or `Class::method` names, with a zero-based argument
`position` and its named-argument `name`:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        dependencyFileReaders:
            'App\Config\Loader::load':
                position: 0
                name: path
            'App\readConfig':
                position: 1
                name: filename
```

Registrations support functions, static and instance methods, and constructors
using `Class::__construct`. Inherited methods use their declaring class name.
Names are case-insensitive. These entries extend the built-ins or override the
argument definition of an existing reader. Arbitrary string arguments are never
interpreted as filesystem paths.

## Diagnostics and Disabling

Each error names the source file, destination file, symbol or reader, and matched
target pattern, followed by an instruction to remove the dependency or move the
shared responsibility to an allowed location. A file reference includes non-PHP
data such as JSON fixtures.

The rule follows `toolkit.allRules`, which defaults to `true`. Guard's existing
`phpstan.all-rules` policy checks that shared switch. Disable this rule explicitly
with:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        forbidDependency:
            enabled: false
```

## Rector

**Unavailable** — no automatic transformation is provided.

Repair requires choosing an allowed dependency direction, moving responsibilities, or introducing a boundary. Removing a reference would discard behavior.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Composer\InstalledVersions;

$packageRoot = dirname(__DIR__);
$autoloadPath = $packageRoot . '/vendor/autoload.php';

if (!is_file($autoloadPath)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, 'Composer dependencies are missing. Run "composer install" in this package first.' . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

require $autoloadPath;

if (!InstalledVersions::isInstalled('phpunit/phpunit')) {
    fwrite(STDERR, 'PHPUnit is not installed. Require phpunit/phpunit before running tests.' . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

$phpUnitVersion = InstalledVersions::getVersion('phpunit/phpunit');

if ($phpUnitVersion === null) {
    fwrite(STDERR, 'The installed phpunit/phpunit package does not expose a version. Install a tagged release.' . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

$phpUnitMajor = explode('.', $phpUnitVersion)[0];
$configurations = [
    '9' => 'phpunit9.xml.dist',
    '10' => 'phpunit10.xml.dist',
    '11' => 'phpunit11.xml.dist',
    '12' => 'phpunit12.xml.dist',
    '13' => 'phpunit.xml.dist',
];
$configuration = $configurations[$phpUnitMajor] ?? null;

if ($configuration === null) {
    fwrite(STDERR, sprintf(
        'Installed PHPUnit major %s is unsupported. Add its configuration to the test runner map.',
        $phpUnitMajor,
    ) . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

$configurationPath = $packageRoot . '/' . $configuration;

if (!is_file($configurationPath)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, sprintf(
        'PHPUnit %s requires %s next to this package\'s composer.json.',
        $phpUnitMajor,
        $configuration,
    ) . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

$rawArguments = $_SERVER['argv'] ?? null;

if (!is_array($rawArguments)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, 'CLI arguments are unavailable. Run tests/run.php from the command line.' . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

$arguments = [];

foreach (array_slice($rawArguments, 1) as $argument) {
    if (!is_string($argument)) {
        fwrite(STDERR, 'A CLI argument is invalid. Pass only string arguments to tests/run.php.' . PHP_EOL);
        exit(1);
    }

    $arguments[] = $argument;
}

$parallel = ($arguments[0] ?? null) === '--parallel';

if ($parallel) {
    array_shift($arguments);
}

$runner = $packageRoot . '/vendor/bin/' . ($parallel ? 'paratest' : 'phpunit');

if (!is_file($runner)) {
    fwrite(STDERR, sprintf(
        '%s is not installed. Require the matching development dependency first.',
        $parallel ? 'ParaTest' : 'PHPUnit',
    ) . PHP_EOL);
    exit(1);
}

$memoryLimit = ini_get('memory_limit');

if ($parallel) {
    array_unshift($arguments, '--passthru-php=-d memory_limit=' . $memoryLimit);
}

$command = array_map(
    static fn (string $argument): string => escapeshellarg($argument),
    [
        PHP_BINARY,
        '-d',
        'memory_limit=' . $memoryLimit,
        $runner,
        '--configuration',
        $configurationPath,
        ...$arguments,
    ],
);

passthru(implode(' ', $command), $exitCode);
exit($exitCode);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Support;

use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;

/**
 * Detects whether the current scope is within a test class namespace.
 */
final class TestClassScope
{
    /**
     * @var list<string>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $testNamespacePrefixes;

    /**
     * @var list<string>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes;

    /**
     * @param list<string> $testNamespacePrefixes namespace prefixes that identify test classes
     * @param list<string> $restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes namespace prefixes for stricter test rules
     */
    public function __construct(
        array $testNamespacePrefixes = ['Tests'],
        array $restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes = ['Tests\\Unit', 'Tests\\Integration', 'Tests\\Property'],
    ) {
        $this->testNamespacePrefixes = array_map(
            static fn (string $prefix): string => rtrim($prefix, '\\') . '\\',
            $testNamespacePrefixes,
        );
        $this->restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes = array_map(
            static fn (string $prefix): string => rtrim($prefix, '\\') . '\\',
            $restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Determines whether the current scope is inside a test class.
     */
    public function isTestClass(Scope $scope): bool
    {
        if ($this->isPropertyTestClass($scope)) {
            return true;
        }

        $classReflection = $scope->getClassReflection();
        if ($classReflection === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $className = ltrim($classReflection->getName(), '\\');

        foreach ($this->testNamespacePrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (str_starts_with($className, $prefix)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Determines whether the current scope is inside a restricted test class.
     */
    public function isRestrictedTestClass(Scope $scope): bool
    {
        if ($this->isPropertyTestClass($scope)) {
            return true;
        }

        if (!$this->isTestClass($scope)) {
            return false;
        }

        $classReflection = $scope->getClassReflection();
        if ($classReflection === null) {
            return false;
        }

        $className = ltrim($classReflection->getName(), '\\');

        foreach ($this->restrictedTestNamespacePrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (str_starts_with($className, $prefix)) {
                return true;
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Identifies named property tests by directory, namespace, or PHPUnit class convention.
     */
    public function isPropertyTestClass(Scope $scope): bool
    {
        $class = $scope->getClassReflection();
        if ($class === null || $class->isAnonymous()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (str_contains('/' . str_replace('\\', '/', $scope->getFile()), '/tests/Property/')
            || str_starts_with($class->getName(), 'Tests\\Property\\')) {
            return true;
        }

        if (!$class->isSubclassOf('PHPUnit\\Framework\\TestCase')) {
            return false;
        }

        return str_ends_with($class->getName(), 'Properties') || $class->hasTraitUse('Eris\\TestTrait');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\TestClass;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\Class_;
use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;
use PHPStan\Node\InClassNode;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\Rule;
use PHPStan\Rules\RuleErrorBuilder;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Support\TestClassScope;

/**
 * Enforces the directory, class, and method conventions for property tests.
 *
 * @implements Rule<InClassNode>
 */
final class PropertyTestConventionRule implements Rule
{
    /**
     * Creates the rule with the shared test scope detector.
     */
    public function __construct(private TestClassScope $testClassScope)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string<InClassNode>
     */
    public function getNodeType(): string
    {
        return InClassNode::class;
    }

    /**
     * @param InClassNode $node
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function processNode(Node $node, Scope $scope): array
    {
        $class = $node->getOriginalNode();
        if (!$class instanceof Class_ || !$this->testClassScope->isPropertyTestClass($scope)) {
            return [];
        }

        $className = $node->getClassReflection()->getName();
        $name = $class->name !== null ? $class->name->toString() : '';
        $errors = [];
        if (!str_contains('/' . str_replace('\\', '/', $scope->getFile()), '/tests/Property/')) {
            $errors[] = RuleErrorBuilder::message(sprintf('Move property test class %s to tests/Property/%s.php. Property tests must be stored under tests/Property.', $className, $name))
                ->identifier('customRules.propertyTestLocation')->line($class->getStartLine())->build();
        }
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*Properties$/D', $name) !== 1) {
            $errors[] = RuleErrorBuilder::message(sprintf('Rename property test class %s to <Name>Properties (for example CollectionProperties) and use the same PHP filename.', $className))
                ->identifier('customRules.propertyTestClassName')->line($class->getStartLine())->build();
        }
        if ($class->extends === null || $class->extends->toString() !== 'PHPUnit\\Framework\\TestCase') {
            $errors[] = RuleErrorBuilder::message(sprintf('Make property test class %s extend PHPUnit\\Framework\\TestCase directly. Move shared test behavior to collaborators.', $className))
                ->identifier('customRules.propertyTestExtends')->line($class->getStartLine())->build();
        }
        $validator = new PropertyTestMethodValidator();
        foreach ($class->getMethods() as $method) {
            $errors = array_merge($errors, $validator->errors($method, $className));
        }

        return $errors;
    }
}

2	
3	| Property | Value |
4	|----------|-------|
5	| Identifiers | `customRules.propertyTestLocation`, `customRules.propertyTestClassName`, `customRules.propertyTestExtends`, `customRules.propertyTestMethodName`, `customRules.propertyTestMethodSignature`, `customRules.propertyTestDiscovery` |
6	| Scope | Classes under `tests/Property`, in `Tests\Property`, or PHPUnit subclasses named `*Properties` or using `Eris\TestTrait` |
7	| Rector | Unavailable |
8	| Configuration | `toolkit.propertyTestConvention.enabled` (inherits `allRules`) |
9	
10	## What it checks
11	
12	Property tests belong under `tests/Property`, with a class named `<Name>Properties` extending `PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase` directly. Guard's `pbt` preset restricts their filenames to `*Properties.php`.
13	
14	Every method declared in the class must be named `satisfies<PropertyName>`, with an uppercase letter after `satisfies`. The method must be public, concrete, non-static, and have no parameters. Generate inputs inside the method. Helpers, constructors, lifecycle overrides such as `setUp`, and data providers cannot be declared in a property test class.
15	
16	Mark each method with PHPUnit's `#[Test]` attribute so it runs despite not starting with `test`. Projects using PHPUnit 9 must use `@test`; projects supporting both versions can carry both markers. The rule requires the attribute when PHPUnit 10+ is installed and accepts the annotation on PHPUnit 9.
17	
18	```php
19	<?php
20	
21	namespace Tests\Property;
22	
23	use Eris\Generators;
24	use Eris\TestTrait;
25	use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
26	use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
27	
28	final class IntegerProperties extends TestCase
29	{
30	    use TestTrait;
31	
32	    #[Test]
33	    public function satisfiesAdditionIdentity(): void
34	    {
35	        $this->forAll(Generators::int())->then(function (int $value): void {
36	            self::assertSame($value, $value + 0);
37	        });
38	    }
39	}
40	```
41	
42	## Shared test rules
43	
44	Property tests also receive the existing restrictions on declared properties, class constants, private methods, helper traits, Reflection, broken-code expectations, redundant assertions, and control flow in test methods. The control-flow rule keeps its existing boundary: nested closures and anonymous classes are separate scopes. `Tests\Property` is included in the default restricted namespaces for descriptive PHPDoc and public API documentation rules.
45	
46	`Eris\TestTrait` is allowed without trait adaptations because it supplies the PBT framework. Other traits remain prohibited. PHPUnit mock API restrictions do not apply to property tests, including concrete-class mocks. The Unit naming and source/test pairing conventions are not imposed on property test methods; property tests do not replace Unit test coverage requirements.
47	
48	## Guard configuration
49	
50	Import `vendor/k-kinzal/guard-php/rules/pbt.yaml`, alongside the project's PHPUnit and PHPStan presets. `guard init` selects it automatically when `giorgiosironi/eris` is installed. The preset requires Composer scripts containing `--testsuite=unit` for `test:unit` and `--testsuite=property` for `test:pbt`.
51	
52	For each selected PHPUnit preset, `guard init` adds a property suite requirement when `tests/Property` exists or the `pbt` preset is selected. It also requires the discovery suffix:
53	
54	```xml
55	<testsuite name="property">
56	    <directory suffix="Properties.php">tests/Property</directory>
57	</testsuite>
58	```
59	
60	Existing Guard configurations must add these suite requirements when adopting PBT; importing `pbt.yaml` alone does not regenerate project-specific PHPUnit rules. Keep `tests/Property` in PHPStan's analysis paths.
61	
62	## Rector
63	
64	No automatic rewrite is provided: the property name and the move of setup behavior require a test author to choose the intended semantics.

10	## What it checks
11	
12	Property tests belong under `tests/Property`, with a class named `<Name>Properties` extending `PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase` directly. Guard's `pbt` preset restricts their filenames to `*Properties.php`.
13	
14	Every method declared in the class must be named `satisfies<PropertyName>`, with an uppercase letter after `satisfies`. The method must be public, concrete, non-static, and have no parameters. Generate inputs inside the method. Helpers, constructors, lifecycle overrides such as `setUp`, and data providers cannot be declared in a property test class.
15	
16	Mark each method with PHPUnit's `#[Test]` attribute so it runs despite not starting with `test`. Projects using PHPUnit 9 must use `@test`; projects supporting both versions can carry both markers. The rule requires the attribute when PHPUnit 10+ is installed and accepts the annotation on PHPUnit 9.
17	
18	```php

20	
21	namespace Tests\Property;
22	
23	use Eris\Generators;
24	use Eris\TestTrait;
25	use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
26	use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
27	
28	final class IntegerProperties extends TestCase
29	{
30	    use TestTrait;
31	
32	    #[Test]
33	    public function satisfiesAdditionIdentity(): void
34	    {
35	        $this->forAll(Generators::int())->then(function (int $value): void {
36	            self::assertSame($value, $value + 0);
37	        });
38	    }
39	}
40	```
41	
42	## Shared test rules
43	
44	Property tests also receive the existing restrictions on declared properties, class constants, private methods, helper traits, Reflection, broken-code expectations, redundant assertions, and control flow in test methods. The control-flow rule keeps its existing boundary: nested closures and anonymous classes are separate scopes. `Tests\Property` is included in the default restricted namespaces for descriptive PHPDoc and public API documentation rules.
45	
46	`Eris\TestTrait` is allowed without trait adaptations because it supplies the PBT framework. Other traits remain prohibited. PHPUnit mock API restrictions do not apply to property tests, including concrete-class mocks. The Unit naming and source/test pairing conventions are not imposed on property test methods; property tests do not replace Unit test coverage requirements.
47	
48	## Guard configuration
49	
50	Import `vendor/k-kinzal/guard-php/rules/pbt.yaml`, alongside the project's PHPUnit and PHPStan presets. `guard init` selects it automatically when `giorgiosironi/eris` is installed. The preset requires Composer scripts containing `--testsuite=unit` for `test:unit` and `--testsuite=property` for `test:pbt`.
51	
52	For each selected PHPUnit preset, `guard init` adds a property suite requirement when `tests/Property` exists or the `pbt` preset is selected. It also requires the discovery suffix:

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\TestClass;

use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\RuleErrorBuilder;

/**
 * Validates PHPUnit test method naming conventions.
 */
final class TestMethodNameValidator
{
    /**
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function errors(string $methodName, int $line): array
    {
        $suffix = substr($methodName, 4);

        if ($suffix === '') {
            return [
                RuleErrorBuilder::message(
                    'Rename test() to test[MethodName] or test[MethodName][Behavior], e.g. testUserCanLogin().'
                )
                    ->identifier('customRules.testMethodNamingConvention')
                    ->line($line)
                    ->build(),
            ];
        }

        if (preg_match('/^[A-Z]$/', $suffix[0]) !== 1) {
            return [
                RuleErrorBuilder::message(
                    sprintf(
                        'Rename test method %s() to use PascalCase after the "test" prefix, e.g. testSomething().',
                        $methodName
                    )
                )
                    ->identifier('customRules.testMethodNamingConvention')
                    ->line($line)
                    ->build(),
            ];
        }

        if (preg_match('/^(Construct|Destruct)/', $suffix) === 1) {
            return [
                RuleErrorBuilder::message(
                    sprintf(
                        'Rename %s() and test behavior through the public API instead of targeting a constructor or destructor.',
                        $methodName
                    )
                )
                    ->identifier('customRules.testMethodProhibitedConstructorDestructor')
                    ->line($line)
                    ->build(),
            ];
        }

        return [];
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\TestClass;

use PhpParser\Node\Stmt\ClassMethod;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\TestClass\Pairing\SourceUnitTestFileResolver;

/**
 * Validates that each public source method has a matching unit test method.
 */
final class PublicMethodTestCoverageValidator
{
    /** @readonly */
    private SourceUnitTestFileResolver $testFileResolver;

    /** @readonly */
    private TestMethodFileReader $testMethodFileReader;

    /** @readonly */
    private PublicMethodTestCoverageErrorBuilder $errorBuilder;

    /**
     * Creates a public method test coverage validator.
     */
    public function __construct(
        ?SourceUnitTestFileResolver $testFileResolver = null,
        ?TestMethodFileReader $testMethodFileReader = null,
        ?PublicMethodTestCoverageErrorBuilder $errorBuilder = null,
    ) {
        $this->testFileResolver = $testFileResolver ?? new SourceUnitTestFileResolver();
        $this->testMethodFileReader = $testMethodFileReader ?? new TestMethodFileReader();
        $this->errorBuilder = $errorBuilder ?? new PublicMethodTestCoverageErrorBuilder();
    }

    /**
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function errors(ClassMethod $node, string $sourceFile): array
    {
        if (!$node->isPublic() || $node->isAbstract()) {
            return [];
        }

        $methodName = $node->name->toString();

        if (str_starts_with($methodName, '__')) {
            return [];
        }

        $testFile = $this->testFileResolver->resolve($sourceFile);
        if ($testFile === null || !is_file($testFile)) {
            return [];
        }

        $expectedPrefix = 'test' . ucfirst($methodName);
        foreach ($this->testMethodFileReader->methodNames($testFile) as $testMethod) {
            if (str_starts_with($testMethod, $expectedPrefix)) {
                return [];
            }
        }

        return [$this->errorBuilder->build($methodName, $expectedPrefix, $node->getStartLine())];
    }
}

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * PSR-4 namespace-to-directory entries declared in a project's composer.json.
 */
final class ComposerAutoloadMap
{
    /**
     * @var list<array{string, string}>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $entries;

    /**
     * @param list<array{string, string}> $entries namespace prefix without trailing separator and root-relative directory
     */
    public function __construct(array $entries)
    {
        $this->entries = [];
        foreach ($entries as [$namespace, $directory]) {
            $this->entries[] = [trim($namespace, '\\'), self::normalizePath($directory)];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reads the autoload and autoload-dev PSR-4 sections of composer.json under the project root.
     */
    public static function fromProjectRoot(string $projectRoot): self
    {
        $file = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $projectRoot), '/') . '/composer.json';
        if (!is_file($file)) {
            return new self([]);
        }

        $json = file_get_contents($file);
        $decoded = $json === false ? null : json_decode($json, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            return new self([]);
        }

        $entries = [];
        foreach (['autoload', 'autoload-dev'] as $section) {
            $block = $decoded[$section] ?? null;
            $psr4 = is_array($block) ? $block['psr-4'] ?? null : null;
            if (!is_array($psr4)) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($psr4 as $namespace => $directories) {
                foreach (is_array($directories) ? $directories : [$directories] as $directory) {
                    if (is_string($directory)) {
                        $entries[] = [(string) $namespace, $directory];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return new self($entries);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a directory value to slash-separated form without a leading "./" or surrounding slashes.
     */
    public static function normalizePath(string $path): string
    {
        $normalized = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, './')) {
            $normalized = substr($normalized, 2);
        }

        return $normalized === '.' ? '' : $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the namespace that PSR-4 assigns to a root-relative directory, or null when no entry covers it.
     */
    public function namespaceForPath(string $path): ?string
    {
        $target = self::normalizePath($path);
        $namespace = null;
        $matched = -1;
        foreach ($this->entries as [$prefix, $directory]) {
            $inside = $directory === '' || $target === $directory || str_starts_with($target, $directory . '/');
            if (!$inside || strlen($directory) <= $matched) {
                continue;
            }

            $remainder = $directory === '' ? $target : substr($target, strlen($directory) + 1);
            $namespace = trim($prefix . '\\' . str_replace('/', '\\', $remainder), '\\');
            $matched = strlen($directory);
        }

        return $namespace;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the root-relative PHP file PSR-4 expects for a class, or null when no entry covers its namespace.
     */
    public function fileForClass(string $class): ?string
    {
        $file = null;
        $matched = -1;
        foreach ($this->entries as [$namespace, $directory]) {
            $prefix = $namespace === '' ? '' : $namespace . '\\';
            if (!str_starts_with($class, $prefix) || strlen($prefix) <= $matched) {
                continue;
            }

            $relative = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, strlen($prefix)));
            $file = ($directory === '' ? '' : $directory . '/') . $relative . '.php';
            $matched = strlen($prefix);
        }

        return $file;
    }
}

{

final class ClassNamePattern
{
    /** @readonly */
    private string $prefix;

    /** @readonly */
    private string $suffix;

    /**
     * @param string $pattern class name template; a pattern without "{name}" is a namespace prefix
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $pattern,
    ) {
        $position = strpos($pattern, '{name}');
        if ($position === false) {
            $this->prefix = $pattern === '' ? '' : rtrim($pattern, '\\') . '\\';
            $this->suffix = '';

            return;
        }

        $this->prefix = substr($pattern, 0, $position);
        $this->suffix = substr($pattern, $position + strlen('{name}'));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the template as configured.
     */
    public function pattern(): string
    {
        return $this->pattern;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the text "{name}" stands for in the class, or null when the class does not match.
     */
    public function capture(string $class): ?string
    {
        $fixed = strlen($this->prefix) + strlen($this->suffix);
        if (strlen($class) <= $fixed || !str_starts_with($class, $this->prefix) || !str_ends_with($class, $this->suffix)) {
            return null;

            return null;
        }

        return $name;
    }

    /**

     */
    public function expand(string $name): string
    {
        return $this->prefix . $name . $this->suffix;
    }
}

{

    private array $expressions;

    /**
     * @param list<string> $patterns class name globs; "*" matches any text and "?" one character

    public function __construct(array $patterns)
    {
        $this->expressions = [];
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            $this->expressions[] = '/^' . str_replace(['\*', '\?'], ['.*', '.'], preg_quote($pattern, '/')) . '$/D';

    public function matches(string $class): bool
    {
        foreach ($this->expressions as $expression) {
            if (preg_match($expression, $class) === 1) {
                return true;
            }
        }

    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * Resolves configured class pair definitions against a project's Composer autoload map.
 */
final class ClassPairSet
{
    /**
     * The shipped pair: each class under the namespace of src/ needs a *Test class under the namespace of tests/Unit/.
     */
    public const DEFAULTS = [
        ['from' => '${src}\{name}', 'to' => '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'],
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<ClassPair>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $pairs;

    /**
     * @param ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload PSR-4 entries that resolve "${directory}" placeholders
     * @param list<array{from: string, to: string, exclude?: list<string>}> $definitions configured pairs
     */
    public function __construct(ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload, array $definitions = self::DEFAULTS)
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander($autoload);
        $this->pairs = [];
        foreach ($definitions as $definition) {
            $from = $expander->expand($definition['from']);
            $to = $expander->expand($definition['to']);
            if ($from === null || $to === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $exclude = [];
            foreach ($definition['exclude'] ?? [] as $pattern) {
                $expanded = $expander->expand($pattern);
                if ($expanded !== null) {
                    $exclude[] = $expanded;
                }
            }

            $this->pairs[] = new ClassPair(new ClassNamePattern($from), new ClassNamePattern($to), new ClassNameGlob($exclude));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the pairs whose placeholders all resolved.
     *
     * @return list<ClassPair>
