use PhpParser\Node;
use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;
use PHPStan\Node\InClassNode;
use PHPStan\Reflection\ReflectionProvider;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\Rule;

/**
 * Requires that a class matching one configured name template is paired with a class matching another.
 *
 * @implements Rule<InClassNode>
 */
final class RequireClassPairRule implements Rule
{
    /** @readonly */
    private ClassPairSet $pairs;

    /** @readonly */
    private ClassPairErrorBuilder $errorBuilder;

    /**
     * @param ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider resolves whether the paired class exists
     * @param string $classPairProjectRoot directory holding the composer.json that resolves "${directory}" placeholders
     * @param list<array{from: string, to: string, exclude?: list<string>}> $classPairs pair definitions
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider,
        string $classPairProjectRoot,
        array $classPairs = ClassPairSet::DEFAULTS,
    ) {
        $autoload = ComposerAutoloadMap::fromProjectRoot($classPairProjectRoot);
        $this->pairs = new ClassPairSet($autoload, $classPairs);
        $this->errorBuilder = new ClassPairErrorBuilder($autoload);
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string<InClassNode>
     */
    public function getNodeType(): string
    {
        return InClassNode::class;
    }

    /**
     * @param InClassNode $node
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function processNode(Node $node, Scope $scope): array
    {
        $reflection = $node->getClassReflection();
        if ($reflection->isAnonymous()) {
            return [];
        }

        $class = $reflection->getName();
        $line = $node->getOriginalNode()->getStartLine();
        $errors = [];
        foreach ($this->pairs->pairs() as $pair) {
            if ($pair->excludes($class)) {
                continue;
            }

            $counterpart = $pair->counterpartOf($class);
            if ($counterpart !== null && !$this->reflectionProvider->hasClass($counterpart)) {
                $errors[] = $this->errorBuilder->missing($class, $counterpart, $pair, $line);
            }

            $origin = $pair->originOf($class);
            if ($origin !== null && !$this->reflectionProvider->hasClass($origin)) {
                $errors[] = $this->errorBuilder->orphaned($class, $origin, $pair, $line);
            }
        }

        return $errors;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * PSR-4 namespace-to-directory entries declared in a project's composer.json.
 */
final class ComposerAutoloadMap
{
    /**
     * @var list<array{string, string}>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $entries;

    /**
     * @param list<array{string, string}> $entries namespace prefix without trailing separator and root-relative directory
     */
    public function __construct(array $entries)
    {
        $this->entries = [];
        foreach ($entries as [$namespace, $directory]) {
            $this->entries[] = [trim($namespace, '\\'), self::normalizePath($directory)];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reads the autoload and autoload-dev PSR-4 sections of composer.json under the project root.
     */
    public static function fromProjectRoot(string $projectRoot): self
    {
        $file = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $projectRoot), '/') . '/composer.json';
        if (!is_file($file)) {
            return new self([]);
        }

        $json = file_get_contents($file);
        $decoded = $json === false ? null : json_decode($json, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            return new self([]);
        }

        $entries = [];
        foreach (['autoload', 'autoload-dev'] as $section) {
            $block = $decoded[$section] ?? null;
            $psr4 = is_array($block) ? $block['psr-4'] ?? null : null;
            if (!is_array($psr4)) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($psr4 as $namespace => $directories) {
                foreach (is_array($directories) ? $directories : [$directories] as $directory) {
                    if (is_string($directory)) {
                        $entries[] = [(string) $namespace, $directory];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return new self($entries);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a directory value to slash-separated form without a leading "./" or surrounding slashes.
     */
    public static function normalizePath(string $path): string
    {
        $normalized = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, './')) {
            $normalized = substr($normalized, 2);
        }

        return $normalized === '.' ? '' : $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the namespace that PSR-4 assigns to a root-relative directory, or null when no entry covers it.
     */
    public function namespaceForPath(string $path): ?string
    {
        $target = self::normalizePath($path);
        $namespace = null;
        $matched = -1;
        foreach ($this->entries as [$prefix, $directory]) {
            $inside = $directory === '' || $target === $directory || str_starts_with($target, $directory . '/');
            if (!$inside || strlen($directory) <= $matched) {
                continue;
            }

            $remainder = $directory === '' ? $target : substr($target, strlen($directory) + 1);
            $namespace = trim($prefix . '\\' . str_replace('/', '\\', $remainder), '\\');
            $matched = strlen($directory);
        }

        return $namespace;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the root-relative PHP file PSR-4 expects for a class, or null when no entry covers its namespace.
     */
    public function fileForClass(string $class): ?string
    {
        $file = null;
        $matched = -1;
        foreach ($this->entries as [$namespace, $directory]) {
            $prefix = $namespace === '' ? '' : $namespace . '\\';
            if (!str_starts_with($class, $prefix) || strlen($prefix) <= $matched) {
                continue;
            }

            $relative = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, strlen($prefix)));
            $file = ($directory === '' ? '' : $directory . '/') . $relative . '.php';
            $matched = strlen($prefix);
        }

        return $file;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * Replaces "${directory}" placeholders with the namespace Composer maps to that directory.
 */
final class AutoloadPlaceholderExpander
{
    /**
     * @param ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload PSR-4 entries used to resolve placeholders
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the pattern with every placeholder replaced, or null when a directory has no PSR-4 namespace.
     */
    public function expand(string $pattern): ?string
    {
        preg_match_all('/\$\{([^}]*)\}/', $pattern, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER);

        $expanded = $pattern;
        foreach ($matches as $match) {
            $namespace = $this->autoload->namespaceForPath($match[1]);
            if ($namespace === null) {
                return null;
            }

            $expanded = str_replace($match[0], $namespace, $expanded);
        }

        return ltrim($expanded, '\\');
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * A fully qualified class name template with one "{name}" placeholder.
 */
final class ClassNamePattern
{
    /** @readonly */
    private string $prefix;

    /** @readonly */
    private string $suffix;

    /**
     * @param string $pattern class name template; a pattern without "{name}" is a namespace prefix
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $pattern,
    ) {
        $position = strpos($pattern, '{name}');
        if ($position === false) {
            $this->prefix = $pattern === '' ? '' : rtrim($pattern, '\\') . '\\';
            $this->suffix = '';

            return;
        }

        $this->prefix = substr($pattern, 0, $position);
        $this->suffix = substr($pattern, $position + strlen('{name}'));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the template as configured.
     */
    public function pattern(): string
    {
        return $this->pattern;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the text "{name}" stands for in the class, or null when the class does not match.
     */
    public function capture(string $class): ?string
    {
        $fixed = strlen($this->prefix) + strlen($this->suffix);
        if (strlen($class) <= $fixed || !str_starts_with($class, $this->prefix) || !str_ends_with($class, $this->suffix)) {
            return null;
        }

        $name = substr($class, strlen($this->prefix), strlen($class) - $fixed);
        if (preg_match('/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\\\\[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*$/D', $name) !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        return $name;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the class name produced by substituting "{name}".
     */
    public function expand(string $name): string
    {
        return $this->prefix . $name . $this->suffix;
    }
}

/**
 * Matches fully qualified class names against glob patterns where "*" spans namespace separators.
 */
final class ClassNameGlob
{
    /**
     * @var list<string>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $expressions;

    /**
     * @param list<string> $patterns class name globs; "*" matches any text and "?" one character
     */
    public function __construct(array $patterns)
    {
        $this->expressions = [];
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            $this->expressions[] = '/^' . str_replace(['\*', '\?'], ['.*', '.'], preg_quote($pattern, '/')) . '$/D';
        }
    }

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * A requirement that every class matching one template is accompanied by a class matching another.
 */
final class ClassPair
{
    /**
     * @param ClassNamePattern $from template of the class that requires a counterpart
     * @param ClassNamePattern $to template of the counterpart
     * @param ClassNameGlob $exclude classes this pair never checks
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private ClassNamePattern $from,
        /** @readonly */
        private ClassNamePattern $to,
        /** @readonly */
        private ClassNameGlob $exclude,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the template of the class that requires a counterpart.
     */
    public function fromPattern(): string
    {
        return $this->from->pattern();
    }

    /**
     * Returns the template of the counterpart.
     */
    public function toPattern(): string
    {
        return $this->to->pattern();
    }

    /**
     * Reports whether the class is excluded from this pair.
     */
    public function excludes(string $class): bool
    {
        return $this->exclude->matches($class);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the counterpart a class matching the "from" template needs, or null when the class does not match.
     */
    public function counterpartOf(string $class): ?string
    {
        $name = $this->from->capture($class);
        if ($name === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $counterpart = $this->to->expand($name);

        return $counterpart === $class ? null : $counterpart;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the origin a class matching the "to" template needs, or null when the class does not match.
     */
    public function originOf(string $class): ?string
    {
        $name = $this->to->capture($class);
        if ($name === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $origin = $this->from->expand($name);

        return $origin === $class ? null : $origin;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * Resolves configured class pair definitions against a project's Composer autoload map.
 */
final class ClassPairSet
{
    /**
     * The shipped pair: each class under the namespace of src/ needs a *Test class under the namespace of tests/Unit/.
     */
    public const DEFAULTS = [
        ['from' => '${src}\{name}', 'to' => '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'],
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<ClassPair>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $pairs;

    /**
     * @param ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload PSR-4 entries that resolve "${directory}" placeholders
     * @param list<array{from: string, to: string, exclude?: list<string>}> $definitions configured pairs
     */
    public function __construct(ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload, array $definitions = self::DEFAULTS)
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander($autoload);
        $this->pairs = [];
        foreach ($definitions as $definition) {
            $from = $expander->expand($definition['from']);
            $to = $expander->expand($definition['to']);
            if ($from === null || $to === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $exclude = [];
            foreach ($definition['exclude'] ?? [] as $pattern) {
                $expanded = $expander->expand($pattern);
                if ($expanded !== null) {
                    $exclude[] = $expanded;
                }
            }

            $this->pairs[] = new ClassPair(new ClassNamePattern($from), new ClassNamePattern($to), new ClassNameGlob($exclude));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the pairs whose placeholders all resolved.
     *
     * @return list<ClassPair>
     */
    public function pairs(): array
    {
        return $this->pairs;
    }
}

use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;

/**
 * Builds errors for classes whose paired class does not exist.

final class ClassPairErrorBuilder
{
    /**
     * @param ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload PSR-4 entries that locate the file of the missing class
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Builds an error for a class whose counterpart is missing.
     */
    public function missing(string $class, string $counterpart, ClassPair $pair, int $line): IdentifierRuleError
    {
        return RuleErrorBuilder::message(sprintf(
            'Create class "%s"%s for class "%s": every class matching "%s" needs a class matching "%s".',
            $counterpart,
            $this->location($counterpart),
            $class,
            $pair->fromPattern(),
            $pair->toPattern(),
        ))
            ->identifier('customRules.classPairMissing')
            ->line($line)
            ->build();
    }

    /**
     * Builds an error for a counterpart whose origin class is missing.
     */
    public function orphaned(string $class, string $origin, ClassPair $pair, int $line): IdentifierRuleError
    {
        return RuleErrorBuilder::message(sprintf(
            'Create class "%s"%s for class "%s", or remove "%s": every class matching "%s" needs a class matching "%s".',
            $origin,
            $this->location($origin),
            $class,
            $class,
            $pair->toPattern(),
            $pair->fromPattern(),
        ))
            ->identifier('customRules.classPairOrphaned')
            ->line($line)
            ->build();
    }

    /**
     * Returns " in <file>" for a class PSR-4 can place, or an empty string.
     */
    public function location(string $class): string
    {

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;
use PHPStan\Node\InClassNode;
use PHPStan\Reflection\ReflectionProvider;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\Rule;

/**
 * Requires that a class matching one configured name template is paired with a class matching another.
 *
 * @implements Rule<InClassNode>
 */
final class RequireClassPairRule implements Rule
{
    /** @readonly */
    private ClassPairSet $pairs;

    /** @readonly */
    private ClassPairErrorBuilder $errorBuilder;

    /**
     * @param ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider resolves whether the paired class exists
     * @param string $classPairProjectRoot directory holding the composer.json that resolves "${directory}" placeholders
     * @param list<array{from: string, to: string, exclude?: list<string>}> $classPairs pair definitions
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider,
        string $classPairProjectRoot,
        array $classPairs = ClassPairSet::DEFAULTS,
    ) {
        $autoload = ComposerAutoloadMap::fromProjectRoot($classPairProjectRoot);
        $this->pairs = new ClassPairSet($autoload, $classPairs);
        $this->errorBuilder = new ClassPairErrorBuilder($autoload);
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string<InClassNode>
     */
    public function getNodeType(): string
    {
        return InClassNode::class;
    }

    /**
     * @param InClassNode $node
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function processNode(Node $node, Scope $scope): array
    {
        $reflection = $node->getClassReflection();
        if ($reflection->isAnonymous()) {
            return [];
        }

        $class = $reflection->getName();
        $line = $node->getOriginalNode()->getStartLine();
        $errors = [];
        foreach ($this->pairs->pairs() as $pair) {
            if ($pair->excludes($class)) {
                continue;
            }

            $counterpart = $pair->counterpartOf($class);
            if ($counterpart !== null && !$this->reflectionProvider->hasClass($counterpart)) {
                $errors[] = $this->errorBuilder->missing($class, $counterpart, $pair, $line);
            }

            $origin = $pair->originOf($class);
            if ($origin !== null && !$this->reflectionProvider->hasClass($origin)) {
                $errors[] = $this->errorBuilder->orphaned($class, $origin, $pair, $line);
            }
        }

        return $errors;
    }
}

    {
        yield 'prefix only' => ['App\{name}', 'App\Service\User', 'Service\User'];

        yield 'missing suffix' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Service\User', null];
        yield 'nothing left for the name' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Test', null];
        yield 'name ending with separator' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Service\Test', null];
        yield 'prefix is the class itself' => ['App\{name}', 'App', null];
    }

    #[DataProvider('providerCapture')]

#[UsesClass(ClassNameGlob::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassNamePattern::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassPair::class)]
#[UsesClass(ComposerAutoloadMap::class)]
final class ClassPairSetTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPairsResolvePlaceholdersInTheShippedDefault(): void
    {
        $pairs = (new ClassPairSet(new ComposerAutoloadMap([['App', 'src'], ['Tests', 'tests']])))->pairs();

        self::assertCount(1, $pairs);
        self::assertSame('App\{name}', $pairs[0]->fromPattern());
        self::assertSame('Tests\Unit\{name}Test', $pairs[0]->toPattern());
        self::assertSame('Tests\Unit\Service\UserTest', $pairs[0]->counterpartOf('App\Service\User'));
    }

    public function testPairsSkipDefinitionsWithUnmappedPlaceholders(): void
    {
        $set = new ClassPairSet(new ComposerAutoloadMap([['App', 'src']]), [
            ['from' => '${src}\{name}', 'to' => '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'],
            ['from' => '${lib}\{name}', 'to' => 'Tests\{name}Test'],
            ['from' => '${src}\{name}Interface', 'to' => '${src}\Fake\Fake{name}'],
        ]);

        self::assertCount(1, $set->pairs());
        self::assertSame('App\{name}Interface', $set->pairs()[0]->fromPattern());
    }

        ]);

        self::assertTrue($set->pairs()[0]->excludes('App\Generated\Entity'));
        self::assertTrue($set->pairs()[0]->excludes('App\MailerInterface'));
        self::assertFalse($set->pairs()[0]->excludes('App\Mailer'));

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\AutoloadPlaceholderExpander;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\ComposerAutoloadMap;

/**
 * @covers \Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\AutoloadPlaceholderExpander
 * @uses \Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\ComposerAutoloadMap
 */
#[CoversClass(AutoloadPlaceholderExpander::class)]
#[UsesClass(ComposerAutoloadMap::class)]
final class AutoloadPlaceholderExpanderTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testExpandReplacesEachPlaceholderWithItsNamespace(): void
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander(new ComposerAutoloadMap([['App', 'src'], ['Tests', 'tests']]));

        self::assertSame('App\{name}', $expander->expand('${src}\{name}'));
        self::assertSame('Tests\Unit\{name}Test', $expander->expand('${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'));
        self::assertSame('App\Fake\Fake{name}', $expander->expand('${src}\Fake\Fake{name}'));
    }

    public function testExpandKeepsPatternsWithoutPlaceholders(): void
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander(new ComposerAutoloadMap([]));

        self::assertSame('Plain\{name}', $expander->expand('Plain\{name}'));
    }

    public function testExpandReturnsNullForUnmappedDirectory(): void
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander(new ComposerAutoloadMap([['App', 'src']]));

        self::assertNull($expander->expand('${lib}\{name}'));
        self::assertNull($expander->expand('${src}\{name}Test', ) === null ? null : $expander->expand('${src}\{name}') . $expander->expand('${tests}'));
    }

    public function testExpandDropsLeadingSeparatorOfFallbackNamespace(): void
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander(new ComposerAutoloadMap([['', 'src']]));

        self::assertSame('{name}', $expander->expand('${src}\{name}'));
    }
}

#[CoversClass(RequireClassPairRule::class)]
#[UsesClass(AutoloadPlaceholderExpander::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassNameGlob::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassNamePattern::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassPair::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassPairErrorBuilder::class)]
#[UsesClass(ClassPairSet::class)]
#[UsesClass(ComposerAutoloadMap::class)]
#[Medium]
final class RequireClassPairRuleTest extends RuleTestCase
{
    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    #[Override]
    public static function getAdditionalConfigFiles(): array
    {
        return [__DIR__ . '/../../../../../rules.neon'];
    }

    #[Override]
    protected function getRule(): Rule
    {
        return new RequireClassPairRule(
            self::createReflectionProvider(),
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project',
        );
    }

    public function testGetNodeTypeInspectsClassDeclarations(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(InClassNode::class, $this->getRule()->getNodeType());
    }

    public function testDistributedRulesEnableClassPairsByDefault(): void
    {
        self::assertNotEmpty(array_filter(
            self::getContainer()->getServicesByTag('phpstan.rules.rule'),
            static fn ($rule): bool => $rule instanceof RequireClassPairRule,
        ));
    }

    public function testProcessNodeReportsClassWithoutCounterpart(): void
    {
        $this->analyse([__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/src/Unpaired.php'], [
            [
                'Create class "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\tests\Unit\UnpairedTest" in tests/Unit/UnpairedTest.php for class "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\src\Unpaired": every class matching "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\src\{name}" needs a class matching "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\tests\Unit\{name}Test".',
                7,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function testProcessNodeAcceptsClassWithCounterpart(): void
    {
        $this->analyse([
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/src/Paired.php',
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/src/Nested/Deep.php',
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/tests/Unit/PairedTest.php',
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/tests/Unit/Nested/DeepTest.php',
        ], []);
    }

    public function testProcessNodeIgnoresFilesWithoutClassDeclarations(): void
    {
        $this->analyse([__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/src/functions.php'], []);
    }

    public function testProcessNodeReportsCounterpartWithoutOrigin(): void
    {
        $this->analyse([__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/tests/Unit/OrphanedTest.php'], [
            [
                'Create class "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\src\Orphaned" in src/Orphaned.php for class "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\tests\Unit\OrphanedTest", or remove "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\tests\Unit\OrphanedTest": every class matching "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\tests\Unit\{name}Test" needs a class matching "Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\src\{name}".',
                7,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function testProcessNodeSkipsExcludedClasses(): void
    {
        $rule = new RequireClassPairRule(
            self::createReflectionProvider(),
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project',
            [['from' => '${src}\{name}', 'to' => '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test', 'exclude' => ['${src}\Skipped']]],
        );

        self::assertSame([], $rule->processNode(
            ...$this->classNodes(__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/src/Skipped.php'),
        ));
    }

    public function testProcessNodeReportsNothingWithoutComposerJson(): void
    {
        $rule = new RequireClassPairRule(
            self::createReflectionProvider(),
            __DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Missing',
        );

        self::assertSame([], $rule->processNode(
            ...$this->classNodes(__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project/src/Unpaired.php'),
        ));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\ComposerAutoloadMap;

/**
 * @covers \Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\ComposerAutoloadMap
 */
#[CoversClass(ComposerAutoloadMap::class)]
final class ComposerAutoloadMapTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testFromProjectRootReadsAutoloadAndAutoloadDevSections(): void
    {
        $map = ComposerAutoloadMap::fromProjectRoot(__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Project');

        self::assertSame('Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\src', $map->namespaceForPath('src'));
        self::assertSame('Tests\PhpStan\ClassPair\Project\tests\Unit', $map->namespaceForPath('tests/Unit'));
    }

    public function testFromProjectRootWithoutComposerJsonHasNoEntries(): void
    {
        $map = ComposerAutoloadMap::fromProjectRoot(__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Missing');

        self::assertNull($map->namespaceForPath('src'));
    }

    public function testFromProjectRootWithoutAutoloadSectionsHasNoEntries(): void
    {
        $map = ComposerAutoloadMap::fromProjectRoot(__DIR__ . '/../../../../../tests/PhpStan/ClassPair/Empty');

        self::assertNull($map->namespaceForPath('src'));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{string, string}>
     */
    public static function providerNormalizePath(): iterable
    {
        yield 'trailing slash' => ['src/', 'src'];
        yield 'current directory prefix' => ['./tests', 'tests'];
        yield 'backslashes' => ['src\Sub\\', 'src/Sub'];
        yield 'current directory' => ['.', ''];
        yield 'empty' => ['', ''];
    }

    #[DataProvider('providerNormalizePath')]
    public function testNormalizePathStripsCurrentDirectoryAndSeparators(string $path, string $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, ComposerAutoloadMap::normalizePath($path));
    }

    public function testNamespaceForPathAppendsSubdirectoriesAsNamespaceSegments(): void
    {
        $map = new ComposerAutoloadMap([['App\\', 'src/'], ['Tests\\', './tests']]);

        self::assertSame('App', $map->namespaceForPath('src'));
        self::assertSame('Tests\Unit\Service', $map->namespaceForPath('tests/Unit/Service/'));
        self::assertNull($map->namespaceForPath('lib'));
    }

    public function testNamespaceForPathPrefersTheLongestDirectory(): void
    {
        $map = new ComposerAutoloadMap([['Root', ''], ['App', 'src'], ['App\Sub', 'src/Sub']]);

        self::assertSame('App\Sub\Deep', $map->namespaceForPath('src/Sub/Deep'));
        self::assertSame('Root\lib', $map->namespaceForPath('lib'));
    }

    public function testNamespaceForPathWithFallbackNamespaceReturnsRelativeNamespace(): void
    {
        $map = new ComposerAutoloadMap([['', 'src']]);

        self::assertSame('', $map->namespaceForPath('src'));
        self::assertSame('Sub', $map->namespaceForPath('src/Sub'));
    }

    public function testFileForClassMirrorsNamespaceSegmentsUnderTheDirectory(): void
    {
        $map = new ComposerAutoloadMap([['App', 'src'], ['Tests', 'tests']]);

        self::assertSame('src/Service/User.php', $map->fileForClass('App\Service\User'));
        self::assertSame('tests/Unit/UserTest.php', $map->fileForClass('Tests\Unit\UserTest'));
        self::assertNull($map->fileForClass('Other\Thing'));
    }

    public function testFileForClassPrefersTheLongestNamespace(): void
    {
        $map = new ComposerAutoloadMap([['', ''], ['App', 'src'], ['App\Sub', 'lib/sub']]);

        self::assertSame('lib/sub/Deep.php', $map->fileForClass('App\Sub\Deep'));
        self::assertSame('src/Other.php', $map->fileForClass('App\Other'));
        self::assertSame('Vendor/Thing.php', $map->fileForClass('Vendor\Thing'));
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\ClassNamePattern;

/**
 * @covers \Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair\ClassNamePattern
 */
#[CoversClass(ClassNamePattern::class)]
final class ClassNamePatternTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPatternReturnsTheConfiguredTemplate(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('Tests\Unit\{name}Test', (new ClassNamePattern('Tests\Unit\{name}Test'))->pattern());
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{string, string, string|null}>
     */
    public static function providerCapture(): iterable
    {
        yield 'prefix only' => ['App\{name}', 'App\Service\User', 'Service\User'];
        yield 'prefix and suffix' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Service\UserTest', 'Service\User'];
        yield 'suffix inside name' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\TestCaseTest', 'TestCase'];
        yield 'prefix and infix' => ['App\Fake\Fake{name}', 'App\Fake\FakeMailer', 'Mailer'];
        yield 'namespace without placeholder' => ['App', 'App\Service\User', 'Service\User'];
        yield 'namespace with trailing separator' => ['App\\', 'App\User', 'User'];
        yield 'other namespace' => ['App\{name}', 'Lib\Service\User', null];
        yield 'missing suffix' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Service\User', null];
        yield 'nothing left for the name' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Test', null];
        yield 'name ending with separator' => ['Tests\Unit\{name}Test', 'Tests\Unit\Service\Test', null];
        yield 'prefix is the class itself' => ['App\{name}', 'App', null];
    }

    #[DataProvider('providerCapture')]
    public function testCaptureReturnsTheTextStandingForName(string $pattern, string $class, ?string $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, (new ClassNamePattern($pattern))->capture($class));
    }

    public function testExpandSubstitutesTheName(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('Tests\Unit\Service\UserTest', (new ClassNamePattern('Tests\Unit\{name}Test'))->expand('Service\User'));
        self::assertSame('App\Service\User', (new ClassNamePattern('App'))->expand('Service\User'));
    }
}

# RequireClassPairRule

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Identifiers | `customRules.classPairMissing`, `customRules.classPairOrphaned` |
| Scope | Every named class, interface, trait, and enum declaration in the analyzed paths |
| Rector | Unavailable |
| Configurable | Yes (`classPairs`, `classPairProjectRoot`) |

## What It Detects

A class pair declares that when a class matching one name template exists, a class matching a second template must exist too. The shipped pair requires a unit test class for every production class:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairs:
            -
                from: '${src}\{name}'
                to: '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'
```

`${src}` and `${tests/Unit}` are read from the PSR-4 sections of `composer.json`. With `"App\\": "src/"` under `autoload` and `"Tests\\": "tests/"` under `autoload-dev`, the pair becomes `App\{name}` and `Tests\Unit\{name}Test`. `{name}` stands for the rest of the class name, including nested namespaces, so `App\Service\UserService` needs `Tests\Unit\Service\UserServiceTest`.

### 1. Class without its counterpart (`customRules.classPairMissing`)

```
src/Service/UserService.php      <-- ERROR: no Tests\Unit\Service\UserServiceTest
src/Service/OrderService.php     <-- OK
tests/Unit/Service/OrderServiceTest.php
```

```
Create class "Tests\Unit\Service\UserServiceTest" in tests/Unit/Service/UserServiceTest.php
for class "App\Service\UserService": every class matching "App\{name}" needs a class
matching "Tests\Unit\{name}Test".
```

### 2. Counterpart without its origin (`customRules.classPairOrphaned`)

```
src/Service/OrderService.php
tests/Unit/Service/OrderServiceTest.php    <-- OK
tests/Unit/Service/LegacyServiceTest.php   <-- ERROR: no App\Service\LegacyService
```

```
Create class "App\Service\LegacyService" in src/Service/LegacyService.php for class
"Tests\Unit\Service\LegacyServiceTest", or remove "Tests\Unit\Service\LegacyServiceTest":
every class matching "Tests\Unit\{name}Test" needs a class matching "App\{name}".
```

The file in the message is where PSR-4 expects the missing class. It is omitted when no `composer.json` entry covers the namespace.

## Why This Is an Error

### Missing counterparts

Every production class should have a unit test that pins its behavior. AI code generators often create production code without tests, or create tests for some classes but not others. Declaring the pair makes the gap visible at analysis time rather than during code review, and the same mechanism can require a fake for every interface or a factory for every entity.

### Orphaned counterparts

When a class is renamed or deleted, its test may be left behind. Orphaned tests waste CI time, inflate coverage, and mislead the next reader about which classes exist.

## How to Fix

### For a missing counterpart

Create the class named in the message at the file named in the message:

```php
// tests/Unit/Service/UserServiceTest.php
namespace Tests\Unit\Service;

use App\Service\UserService;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class UserServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCreatePersistsUser(): void
    {
        // ...
    }
}
```

### For an orphaned counterpart

Either delete the stale class or rename it to match the current origin:

```bash
# If the origin was renamed
git mv tests/Unit/Service/LegacyServiceTest.php tests/Unit/Service/ModernServiceTest.php

# If the origin was deleted
git rm tests/Unit/Service/LegacyServiceTest.php
```

## Configuration

### Templates

`from` and `to` are fully qualified class name templates. Each contains one `{name}` placeholder; text before it is a required prefix and text after it a required suffix. A template without `{name}` is a namespace prefix, so `from: '${src}'` means `${src}\{name}`. Matching is case-sensitive and `{name}` only matches valid class name segments, so `Tests\Unit\Test` never matches `Tests\Unit\{name}Test`.

Each pair is checked in both directions: a class matching `from` needs the class produced by `to`, and a class matching `to` needs the class produced by `from`. Pairs whose two templates produce the same class name for a class are ignored.

### Placeholders from `composer.json`

`${directory}` is replaced with the namespace that the `autoload` or `autoload-dev` PSR-4 section maps to that root-relative directory. A subdirectory of a mapped directory receives the mapped namespace plus one segment per path component, which is how `${tests/Unit}` resolves to `Tests\Unit`. The longest mapped directory wins. The `composer.json` is read from `classPairProjectRoot`, which defaults to `%currentWorkingDirectory%`; set it when PHPStan runs from another directory:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairProjectRoot: %rootDir%/../../..
```

A pair whose placeholder names a directory without a PSR-4 mapping is skipped, so the shipped default is inert in a project without a `src/` namespace. Write the namespaces literally when the project autoloads through a classmap.

### Adding pairs

PHPStan merges lists, so a project adds pairs without repeating the default:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairs:
            -
                from: '${src}\{name}Interface'
                to: '${src}\Fake\Fake{name}'
            -
                from: '${src}\Entity\{name}'
                to: '${tests/Unit}\Entity\{name}FactoryTest'
```

Use `classPairs!:` to replace the whole list, or `classPairs!: []` to keep the rule enabled with no pairs.

### Excluding classes

`exclude` lists class name globs that the pair never checks, in either direction. `*` matches any text including namespace separators, `?` matches one character, and `${directory}` placeholders are expanded:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairs:
            -
                from: '${src}\{name}'
                to: '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'
                exclude:
                    - '${src}\Generated\*'
                    - '*Interface'
                    - '${src}\Kernel'
```

### Disabling

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPair:
            enabled: false
```

## Rector

**Unavailable** — no automatic transformation is provided.

A meaningful counterpart carries behavior of its own. Generating an empty class would only hide the violation.

Matching is case-sensitive and `{name}` only matches valid class name segments, so `Tests\Unit\Test` never matches `Tests\Unit\{name}Test`.

Each pair is checked in both directions: a class matching `from` needs the class produced by `to`, and a class matching `to` needs the class produced by `from`. Pairs whose two templates produce the same class name for a class are ignored.

### Placeholders from `composer.json`

`${directory}` is replaced with the namespace that the `autoload` or `autoload-dev` PSR-4 section maps to that root-relative directory. A subdirectory of a mapped directory receives the mapped namespace plus one segment per path component, which is how `${tests/Unit}` resolves to `Tests\Unit`. The longest mapped directory wins. The `composer.json` is read from `classPairProjectRoot`, which defaults to `%currentWorkingDirectory%`; set it when PHPStan runs from another directory:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairProjectRoot: %rootDir%/../../..
```

A pair whose placeholder names a directory without a PSR-4 mapping is skipped, so the shipped default is inert in a project without a `src/` namespace. Write the namespaces literally when the project autoloads through a classmap.

### Adding pairs

PHPStan merges lists, so a project adds pairs without repeating the default:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairs:
            -
                from: '${src}\{name}Interface'
                to: '${src}\Fake\Fake{name}'
            -
                from: '${src}\Entity\{name}'
                to: '${tests/Unit}\Entity\{name}FactoryTest'
```

Use `classPairs!:` to replace the whole list, or `classPairs!: []` to keep the rule enabled with no pairs.

### Excluding classes

`exclude` lists class name globs that the pair never checks, in either direction. `*` matches any text including namespace separators, `?` matches one character, and `${directory}` placeholders are expanded:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairs:
            -
                from: '${src}\{name}'
                to: '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'
                exclude:
                    - '${src}\Generated\*'
                    - '*Interface'
                    - '${src}\Kernel'
```

### Disabling

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPair:
            enabled: false
```

## Rector

**Unavailable** — no automatic transformation is provided.

A meaningful counterpart carries behavior of its own. Generating an empty class would only hide the violation.

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * Matches fully qualified class names against glob patterns where "*" spans namespace separators.
 */
final class ClassNameGlob
{
    /**
     * @var list<string>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $expressions;

    /**
     * @param list<string> $patterns class name globs; "*" matches any text and "?" one character
     */
    public function __construct(array $patterns)
    {
        $this->expressions = [];
        foreach ($patterns as $pattern) {
            $this->expressions[] = '/^' . str_replace(['\*', '\?'], ['.*', '.'], preg_quote($pattern, '/')) . '$/D';
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reports whether any pattern matches the class name.
     */
    public function matches(string $class): bool

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * PSR-4 namespace-to-directory entries declared in a project's composer.json.
 */
final class ComposerAutoloadMap
{
    /**
     * @var list<array{string, string}>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $entries;

    /**
     * @param list<array{string, string}> $entries namespace prefix without trailing separator and root-relative directory
     */
    public function __construct(array $entries)
    {
        $this->entries = [];
        foreach ($entries as [$namespace, $directory]) {
            $this->entries[] = [trim($namespace, '\\'), self::normalizePath($directory)];
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reads the autoload and autoload-dev PSR-4 sections of composer.json under the project root.
     */
    public static function fromProjectRoot(string $projectRoot): self
    {
        $file = rtrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $projectRoot), '/') . '/composer.json';
        if (!is_file($file)) {
            return new self([]);
        }

        $json = file_get_contents($file);
        $decoded = $json === false ? null : json_decode($json, true);
        if (!is_array($decoded)) {
            return new self([]);
        }

        $entries = [];
        foreach (['autoload', 'autoload-dev'] as $section) {
            $block = $decoded[$section] ?? null;
            $psr4 = is_array($block) ? $block['psr-4'] ?? null : null;
            if (!is_array($psr4)) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($psr4 as $namespace => $directories) {
                foreach (is_array($directories) ? $directories : [$directories] as $directory) {
                    if (is_string($directory)) {
                        $entries[] = [(string) $namespace, $directory];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return new self($entries);
    }

    /**
     * Converts a directory value to slash-separated form without a leading "./" or surrounding slashes.
     */
    public static function normalizePath(string $path): string
    {
        $normalized = trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path), '/');
        if (str_starts_with($normalized, './')) {
            $normalized = substr($normalized, 2);
        }

        return $normalized === '.' ? '' : $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the namespace that PSR-4 assigns to a root-relative directory, or null when no entry covers it.
     */
    public function namespaceForPath(string $path): ?string
    {
        $target = self::normalizePath($path);
        $namespace = null;
        $matched = -1;
        foreach ($this->entries as [$prefix, $directory]) {
            $inside = $directory === '' || $target === $directory || str_starts_with($target, $directory . '/');
            if (!$inside || strlen($directory) <= $matched) {
                continue;
            }

            $remainder = $directory === '' ? $target : substr($target, strlen($directory) + 1);
            $namespace = trim($prefix . '\\' . str_replace('/', '\\', $remainder), '\\');
            $matched = strlen($directory);
        }

        return $namespace;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the root-relative PHP file PSR-4 expects for a class, or null when no entry covers its namespace.
     */
    public function fileForClass(string $class): ?string
    {
        $file = null;
        $matched = -1;
        foreach ($this->entries as [$namespace, $directory]) {
            $prefix = $namespace === '' ? '' : $namespace . '\\';
            if (!str_starts_with($class, $prefix) || strlen($prefix) <= $matched) {
                continue;
            }

            $relative = str_replace('\\', '/', substr($class, strlen($prefix)));
            $file = ($directory === '' ? '' : $directory . '/') . $relative . '.php';
            $matched = strlen($prefix);
        }

        return $file;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

/**
 * Resolves configured class pair definitions against a project's Composer autoload map.
 */
final class ClassPairSet
{
    /**
     * The shipped pair: each class under the namespace of src/ needs a *Test class under the namespace of tests/Unit/.
     */
    public const DEFAULTS = [
        ['from' => '${src}\{name}', 'to' => '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'],
    ];

    /**
     * @var list<ClassPair>
     * @readonly
     */
    private array $pairs;

    /**
     * @param ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload PSR-4 entries that resolve "${directory}" placeholders
     * @param list<array{from: string, to: string, exclude?: list<string>}> $definitions configured pairs
     */
    public function __construct(ComposerAutoloadMap $autoload, array $definitions = self::DEFAULTS)
    {
        $expander = new AutoloadPlaceholderExpander($autoload);
        $this->pairs = [];
        foreach ($definitions as $definition) {
            $from = $expander->expand($definition['from']);
            $to = $expander->expand($definition['to']);
            if ($from === null || $to === null) {
                continue;
            }

            $exclude = [];
            foreach ($definition['exclude'] ?? [] as $pattern) {
                $expanded = $expander->expand($pattern);
                if ($expanded !== null) {
                    $exclude[] = $expanded;
                }
            }

            $this->pairs[] = new ClassPair(new ClassNamePattern($from), new ClassNamePattern($to), new ClassNameGlob($exclude));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the pairs whose placeholders all resolved.
     *
     * @return list<ClassPair>
     */
    public function pairs(): array
    {
        return $this->pairs;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Toolkit\PhpStan\Rule\ClassPair;

use PhpParser\Node;
use PHPStan\Analyser\Scope;
use PHPStan\Node\InClassNode;
use PHPStan\Reflection\ReflectionProvider;
use PHPStan\Rules\IdentifierRuleError;
use PHPStan\Rules\Rule;

/**
 * Requires that a class matching one configured name template is paired with a class matching another.
 *
 * @implements Rule<InClassNode>
 */
final class RequireClassPairRule implements Rule
{
    /** @readonly */
    private ClassPairSet $pairs;

    /** @readonly */
    private ClassPairErrorBuilder $errorBuilder;

    /**
     * @param ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider resolves whether the paired class exists
     * @param string $classPairProjectRoot directory holding the composer.json that resolves "${directory}" placeholders
     * @param list<array{from: string, to: string, exclude?: list<string>}> $classPairs pair definitions
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private ReflectionProvider $reflectionProvider,
        string $classPairProjectRoot,
        array $classPairs = ClassPairSet::DEFAULTS,
    ) {
        $autoload = ComposerAutoloadMap::fromProjectRoot($classPairProjectRoot);
        $this->pairs = new ClassPairSet($autoload, $classPairs);
        $this->errorBuilder = new ClassPairErrorBuilder($autoload);
    }

    /**
     * @return class-string<InClassNode>
     */
    public function getNodeType(): string
    {
        return InClassNode::class;
    }

    /**
     * @param InClassNode $node
     * @return list<IdentifierRuleError>
     */
    public function processNode(Node $node, Scope $scope): array
    {
        $reflection = $node->getClassReflection();
        if ($reflection->isAnonymous()) {
            return [];
        }

        $class = $reflection->getName();
        $line = $node->getOriginalNode()->getStartLine();
        $errors = [];
        foreach ($this->pairs->pairs() as $pair) {
            if ($pair->excludes($class)) {
                continue;
            }

            $counterpart = $pair->counterpartOf($class);
            if ($counterpart !== null && !$this->reflectionProvider->hasClass($counterpart)) {
                $errors[] = $this->errorBuilder->missing($class, $counterpart, $pair, $line);
            }

            $origin = $pair->originOf($class);
            if ($origin !== null && !$this->reflectionProvider->hasClass($origin)) {
                $errors[] = $this->errorBuilder->orphaned($class, $origin, $pair, $line);
            }
        }

        return $errors;
    }
}

# RequireClassPairRule

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Identifiers | `customRules.classPairMissing`, `customRules.classPairOrphaned` |
| Scope | Every named class, interface, trait, and enum declaration in the analyzed paths |
| Rector | Unavailable |
| Configurable | Yes (`classPairs`, `classPairProjectRoot`) |

## What It Detects

A class pair declares that when a class matching one name template exists, a class matching a second template must exist too. The shipped pair requires a unit test class for every production class:

```neon
parameters:
    toolkit:
        classPairs:
            -
                from: '${src}\{name}'
                to: '${tests/Unit}\{name}Test'
```

`${src}` and `${tests/Unit}` are read from the PSR-4 sections of `composer.json`. With `"App\\": "src/"` under `autoload` and `"Tests\\": "tests/"` under `autoload-dev`, the pair becomes `App\{name}` and `Tests\Unit\{name}Test`. `{name}` stands for the rest of the class name, including nested namespaces, so `App\Service\UserService` needs `Tests\Unit\Service\UserServiceTest`.

### 1. Class without its counterpart (`customRules.classPairMissing`)

```
src/Service/UserService.php      <-- ERROR: no Tests\Unit\Service\UserServiceTest
src/Service/OrderService.php     <-- OK
tests/Unit/Service/OrderServiceTest.php
```

```
Create class "Tests\Unit\Service\UserServiceTest" in tests/Unit/Service/UserServiceTest.php
for class "App\Service\UserService": every class matching "App\{name}" needs a class
matching "Tests\Unit\{name}Test".
```

### 2. Counterpart without its origin (`customRules.classPairOrphaned`)

```
src/Service/OrderService.php
tests/Unit/Service/OrderServiceTest.php    <-- OK
tests/Unit/Service/LegacyServiceTest.php   <-- ERROR: no App\Service\LegacyService
```

```
Create class "App\Service\LegacyService" in src/Service/LegacyService.php for class
"Tests\Unit\Service\LegacyServiceTest", or remove "Tests\Unit\Service\LegacyServiceTest":
every class matching "Tests\Unit\{name}Test" needs a class matching "App\{name}".
```

The file in the message is where PSR-4 expects the missing class. It is omitted when no `composer.json` entry covers the namespace.

## Why This Is an Error

### Missing counterparts

Every production class should have a unit test that pins its behavior. AI code generators often create production code without tests, or create tests for some classes but not others. Replace SrcUnitTestPairRule with namespace-based RequireClassPairRule

The src/tests pairing rule matched file paths, so it could not express
"when class A exists, class B must exist" for anything but src/ and
tests/Unit/. RequireClassPairRule pairs class name templates instead:
a class matching `from` needs the class produced by `to`, and a class
matching `to` needs the class produced by `from`. `{name}` captures the
rest of the class name, and `${directory}` placeholders are replaced with
the namespace that composer.json maps to that directory, so the shipped
pair `${src}\{name}` -> `${tests/Unit}\{name}Test` works without knowing
the project's namespace. Pairs whose placeholders have no PSR-4 mapping
are skipped.

Each error names the missing class, the PSR-4 file it belongs in, the
class that requires it, and the pair that applies. Projects add pairs
through `classPairs`, exempt classes through `classPairExclude` or a
pair's `exclude`, and point `classPairProjectRoot` at composer.json when
PHPStan runs elsewhere.

The class-based check found three test classes in this package with no
origin class (a test of a classless file and two second test classes
declared inside existing test files); they are listed in
classPairExclude. TestNamingConventionRule keeps using srcMarker and
unitTestMarker for its method coverage check.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
